			New("ImageLabel", {
				Name = "P" .. tostring(i),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Image = asset,
				ImageTransparency = 0.01,
				ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
			}, preloader)
		end
		task.delay(4, function()
			if preloader.Parent then preloader:Destroy() end
		end)
	end)

	if Library.ShowLoader == false then
		task.delay(1, function() if WindowObj._autoLoad then WindowObj._autoLoad() end end)
	end

	return WindowObj
end

return Library

end



-- Shitaro anti-aim modules: full implementations, adapted to the existing loader.
-- Module T
-- Share the penetration module: do not patch bullet upvalues a second time.
D.spinRaycast = function()
  return D.load("L")
end

-- Module ac
D.ac = function()
  local G, i = os.clock, {hooked = false, on = false, fresh = false, broke = false, target = nil, beat = 0, samples = 0, still = 0, ground = false, bx = 0, by = 0, bj = false, input_at = 0}
  i.engage = function(u)
    if not (i.on) then
      i.on = true
      i.fresh = true
      i.broke = false
      i.samples = 0
      i.still = 0
      i.ground = false
    end
    i.target = u
    i.beat = G()
  end
  i.release = function()
    i.on = false
    i.fresh = false
    i.broke = false
    i.target = nil
    i.samples = 0
    i.still = 0
    i.ground = false
  end
  i.active = function(G)
    if not (i.on) then
      return false
    end
    if (G - i.beat) > 0.5 then
      i.release()
      return false
    end
    return true
  end
  return i
end

-- Module ad
D.ad = function()
  local G, i, u = D.load("b"), D.load("a"), D.load("h")
  local j, w, t = D.load("j"), D.load("spinRaycast"), D.load("o")
  local Z = D.load("k").slots
  local h = D.load("ac")
  local A = G.lp
  local B = G.workspace
  local G = j.pose
  local d, _, b = j.grenade, j.inventory, os.clock
  local j = w.probe
  local w = Vector3.new
  local x = math.rad
  local v = math.random
  local H = math.clamp
  local l = math.atan2
  local W = math.cos
  local q, J, D, m, Y, O, Q, F, I, E, V, N, a, U, g = math.sin, 3.141592653589793, {["Counter-Terrorists"] = true, Terrorists = true}, 2, 4.5, 3.5, 0.05, 0.25, 2, 10, {on = false, yaw = "backward", jitter = 45, spin_rate = 25, pitch = "off", air_spin = false, air_rate = 30, air_pitch = "off", duck = false, duck_rate = 4, man = 0, auto = false, ang = 90}, 0
  local X, o, R, p, c = 0, false, {s = 0, at = 0, lk = 0, ch = nil}, {}, false
  local M = ((type(G) == "table") and (type(G.getJoints) == "function")) and (type(G.applyVerticalLook) == "function")
  local function T()
    if M then
      if U then
        pcall(G.applyVerticalLook, U, 0, 0)
      end
    end
  end
  local function L(k)
    if M then
      if not (k) then
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    if g == k then
      if U then
        local P = U
        return P
      end
    end
    T()
    U, g = nil, nil
    local P, z = pcall(G.getJoints, k)
    if P then
      if type(z) == "table" then
        U, g = z, k
      end
    end
    P = U
    return P
  end
  local function k(P)
    local z, n, K, S, e = A:GetAttribute("Team"), B:GetAttribute("Gamemode") == "Deathmatch", b(), u.all()
    local u, C, s, r, yO
    for fO = 1, e, 1 do
      local e = S[fO]
      if e ~= A then
        fO = e:GetAttribute("Team")
        if n or (((((z ~= nil) and (fO ~= nil)) and D[z]) and D[fO]) and (z ~= fO)) then
          local D, z, n = e.Character
          local S = false
          if D then
            if D:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= true then
              if D:IsDescendantOf(B) then
                if D:GetAttribute("ClientCharacterPresentationVisible") ~= false then
                  local B = D:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                  if B then
                    local fO, GO = D:FindFirstChild("Head"), B.Position
                    n = (fO and fO.Position) or (GO + w(0, 1.8, 0))
                    fO = true
                    z, S = GO, fO
                  else
                  end
                else
                end
              else
              end
            else
            end
          else
          end
          local B = r
          if z then
            r = n
          else
            local fO = Z[e]
            local Z = (((fO and (fO.mode == "est")) and (fO.cerr <= E)) and ((K - fO.at) <= I)) and fO.cur
            if Z then
              local I = fO.ghost
              local E = I and I.parts.Head
              r = (E and E.Position) or (Z + w(0, 1.8, 0))
              z = Z
            else
              r = n
            end
          end
          if z then
            local Z = (z - P).Magnitude
            if (if u then S and not C else not u) or ((S == C) and (Z < u)) then
              u, C, s, yO = Z, S, z, (S and D) or nil
            else
              r = B
            end
          else
            r = B
          end
        else
        end
      else
      end
    end
    return s, r, yO
  end
  local function u(Z, B)
    if c then
      return t.clear(Z, B)
    end
    return j(Z, B - Z, nil, p).instance == nil
  end
  local function j(Z, B, D)
    c = t.sync()
    if D then
      local t = u(D, Z - (B * m))
      if t ~= u(D, Z + (B * m)) then
        return (t and 1) or -1
      end
      if t then
        return 0
      end
      t = u(D, Z - (B * Y))
      if t ~= u(D, Z + (B * Y)) then
        return (t and 1) or -1
      end
    end
    D = not u(Z, Z - (B * O))
    if D ~= not u(Z, Z + (B * O)) then
      return (D and -1) or 1
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function u(t, Z, B, D, m)
    local Y = b()
    if R.ch ~= t then
      R.ch = t
      R.s = 0
      R.at = 0
      R.lk = 0
    end
    if Y < R.at then
      return R.s
    end
    R.at = Y + Q
    p[1] = t
    p[2] = m
    local O, Q = Z.Position, t and (t:FindFirstChild("Head"))
    m = w(O.X, (Q and Q.Position.Y) or (O.Y + 1.8), O.Z)
    Q, O = pcall(j, m, w(-W(B), 0, q(B)), D)
    if Q then
      if O ~= nil then
        if O ~= R.s then
          if R.s == 0 then
            R.s, R.lk = O, Y + F
          elseif Y >= R.lk then
            R.s, R.lk = O, Y + F
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return R.s
  end
  local function j()
    if b() < X then
      return true
    elseif h.on then
      return true
    end
    return (A:GetAttribute("IsDefusingBomb") == true) or (A:GetAttribute("IsLocallyDefusingBomb") == true)
  end
  if type(d) == "table" then
    if type(rawget(d, "Throw")) == "function" then
      i.field(d, "Throw", function(w)
        local function t(Z, ...)
          if V.on then
            X = b() + 1.25
          end
          return w(Z, ...)
        end
        return t
      end)
    end
  end
  if type(_) == "table" then
    if type(rawget(_, "PredictGrenadeThrow")) == "function" then
      i.field(_, "PredictGrenadeThrow", function(w)
        local function t(...)
          local Z = w(...)
          if Z == true then
            if V.on then
              X = b() + 0.35
            end
          end
          return Z
        end
        return t
      end)
    end
  end
  d = {cfg = V, reset = function()
    N, a = 0, nil
    R.s = 0
    R.at = 0
    R.lk = 0
  end, relax = function()
    T()
  end, apply = function(w, t)
    if not (V.on) then
      return
    end
    if j() then
      if not (o) then
        o = true
        T()
      end
      return
    end
    o = false
    local j, Z, h = tonumber(t.LookYaw) or 0, tonumber(t.VerticalLook) or 0, w and w.MovementState
    local A = (h and (h.OnGround == false)) and (V.air_spin == true)
    local B, _ = (A and V.air_pitch) or V.pitch
    if A then
      h = N
      N = h + x(tonumber(V.air_rate) or 30)
      _ = j + N
    else
      local b = a
      if b ~= V.yaw then
        N = 0
        a = V.yaw
      end
      local D, m, Y, O = V.yaw, V.man, j + J, w and w.HumanoidRootPart
      if O and ((((m ~= 0) or V.auto) or (D == "backward")) or (D == "jitter")) then
        b = O.Position
        local J, Q, F = k(b)
        if J then
          local I = J - b
          Y = l(I.X, I.Z)
        else
        end
        m = if m == 0 then if V.auto then u(w.Character, O, Y, Q, F) else m else m
      else
      end
      if m ~= 0 then
        _ = Y + (x(tonumber(V.ang) or 90) * (((B == "up") and -m) or m))
      else
        if D == "spin" then
          O = N
          N = O + x(tonumber(V.spin_rate) or 25)
          _ = j + N
        else
          _ = if D == "backward" then Y else if D == "jitter" then Y else j
        end
      end
      _ = if D == "jitter" then _ + x(((v() * 2) - 1) * (tonumber(V.jitter) or 0)) else _
    end
    A = B ~= "off"
    Z = H(if B == "down" then -1 else if B == "up" then 1 else if B == "jitter" then (v() * 2) - 1 else Z, -1, 1)
    t.LookYaw = _
    t.VerticalLook = Z
    if typeof(t.Move) == "Vector2" then
      h = _ - j
      if math.abs(h) > 1e-06 then
        local u, j, _ = W(h), q(h), t.Move
        t.Move = Vector2.new((_.X * u) - (_.Y * j), (_.X * j) + (_.Y * u))
      end
    end
    if V.duck then
      h, B = 1 / (2 * H(tonumber(V.duck_rate) or 4, 1, 12)), tonumber(t.Buttons) or 0
      if (math.floor(os.clock() / h) % 2) == 1 then
        t.Buttons = bit32.bor(B, 2)
      else
        t.Buttons = bit32.band(B, bit32.bnot(2))
      end
    end
    if A then
      if M then
        if w then
          if w.Character then
            t = L(w.Character)
            if t then
              pcall(G.applyVerticalLook, t, Z, 0)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end, unload = function()
    V.on = false
    X, o = 0, false
    T()
    U, g = nil, nil
    R.ch = nil
    table.clear(p)
  end}
  i.teardown(d.unload)
  return d
end

-- Local feedback only: health-confirmed hit sounds and attributed kill notices.
D.dadaFeedback = function(runtime, services, vis, playSound, killEffect)
    local api = {}
    local lp = services.lp
    local states = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local pending = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local frame, layer
    local cards = {}
    local lastSound = -math.huge
    local function make(kind, props, parent)
        local obj = Instance.new(kind)
        for key,value in pairs(props) do obj[key] = value end
        obj.Parent = parent
        return obj
    end
    local function animate(obj, props, seconds)
        if not obj.Parent then return end
        services.tween:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(seconds, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
            Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
    end
    local function health(char)
        local value = tonumber(char:GetAttribute("Health"))
        if value then return value end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        return hum and hum.Health or nil
    end
    local function isDead(char)
        local hp = health(char)
        return char:GetAttribute("Dead") == true or (hp ~= nil and hp <= 0)
    end
    local function isMe(value)
        return value == lp or value == lp.Name or value == lp.UserId
            or value == tostring(lp.UserId)
    end
    local function credited(char, player)
        local value = char:GetAttribute("LastKiller")
        if value ~= nil then return isMe(value) end
        -- Some game versions keep attribution on the player rather than the model.
        value = player and player:GetAttribute("LastKiller")
        if value ~= nil then return isMe(value) end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local tag = hum and hum:FindFirstChild("creator")
        return tag ~= nil and tag:IsA("ObjectValue") and tag.Value == lp
    end
    local function reflow()
        for index,entry in ipairs(cards) do
            animate(entry.node, {Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,(index-1)*44)}, 0.18)
        end
    end
    local function remove(entry)
        for index,value in ipairs(cards) do
            if value == entry then table.remove(cards,index); break end
        end
        if entry.node.Parent then entry.node:Destroy() end
        reflow()
    end
    local function notice(name, preview)
        if not layer or not layer.Parent or not vis.killNotify then return end
        while #cards >= 3 do remove(cards[#cards]) end
        local node = make("CanvasGroup", {
            Name="KillNotice", Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,36), Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,10),
            BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,23,32), BackgroundTransparency=0.35, BorderSizePixel=0,
            GroupTransparency=1, ZIndex=100,
        }, layer)
        make("UICorner", {CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,14)}, node)
        make("Frame", {Size=UDim2.new(0,3,1,-16), Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,8),
            BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(114,188,143), BorderSizePixel=0, ZIndex=101}, node)
        make("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency=1, Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,0), Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,1,0),
            Text=(preview and "ПРИМЕР  ·  " or "УБИЙСТВО  ·  ") .. tostring(name),
            TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(238,241,247), TextSize=12, Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            RichText=false, ZIndex=102,
        }, node)
        local bar = make("Frame", {AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,1), Position=UDim2.new(0,12,1,-4),
            Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,2), BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(114,188,143),
            BackgroundTransparency=0.25, BorderSizePixel=0, ZIndex=102}, node)
        local entry = {node=node}
        table.insert(cards,1,entry)
        reflow()
        animate(node,{GroupTransparency=0},0.2)
        animate(bar,{Size=UDim2.new(0,0,0,2)},3.5)
        runtime.spawn(function()
            task.wait(3.5)
            if not node.Parent then return end
            animate(node,{GroupTransparency=1,Position=node.Position+UDim2.fromOffset(0,8)},0.22)
            task.wait(0.24)
            remove(entry)
        end)
    end
    function api.attach(menu, parent)
        frame = menu
        layer = make("Frame", {Name="DaDaKillNotices", BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Size=UDim2.fromOffset(268,132), ZIndex=100, ClipsDescendants=false}, parent)
        runtime.own(layer)
        runtime.connect(services.run.RenderStepped,function()
            if not layer.Parent or not frame.Parent then return end
            -- Same ScreenGui as the menu: no inset mismatch while dragging/resizing.
            local viewport = parent.AbsoluteSize
            local width = math.max(1,math.min(268,frame.AbsoluteSize.X,viewport.X-24))
            local x = frame.AbsolutePosition.X+(frame.AbsoluteSize.X-width)*0.5
            local y = frame.AbsolutePosition.Y+frame.AbsoluteSize.Y+12
            -- Keep the stack visible on small screens / when the menu is near the bottom.
            x = math.clamp(x,12,math.max(12,viewport.X-width-12))
            y = math.clamp(y,12,math.max(12,viewport.Y-#cards*44-12))
            layer.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y)
            layer.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,132)
            if not vis.killNotify then
                while #cards>0 do remove(cards[#cards]) end
            end
        end)
    end
    function api.preview() notice("Пример игрока",true) end
    local function finishKill(char, state)
        if state.killed or not isDead(char) or not credited(char,state.player) then return end
        state.killed = true
        pending[char] = nil
        local part = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart
        local pos = part and part.Position or state.lastPos
        if vis.killsound then playSound(vis.killSoundIdx,vis.hitVol,1) end
        notice(state.player and state.player.DisplayName or char.Name,false)
        if vis.killfx and typeof(pos)=="Vector3" then killEffect(pos) end
    end
    local function check(char,state)
        local hp = health(char)
        if hp and state.hp and hp < state.hp then
            local shot = pending[char]
            if shot and os.clock()-shot.at <= 1.25 then
                if vis.hitsound and os.clock()-lastSound > 0.065 then
                    lastSound=os.clock()
                    playSound(vis.hitSound,vis.hitVol,vis.hitPitch)
                end
                pending[char]=nil
            end
        end
        if hp then state.hp=hp end
        if isDead(char) then
            finishKill(char,state)
            -- Death and LastKiller may replicate in separate frames.
            if not state.retry and not state.killed then
                state.retry=true
                runtime.spawn(function()
                    for index=1,6 do
                        task.wait(0.15)
                        if state.killed or not char.Parent then break end
                        finishKill(char,state)
                    end
                    state.retry=false
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    local function bindCharacter(char,player)
        if states[char] then return states[char] end
        local state={player=player,hp=health(char),killed=isDead(char),connections={}}
        states[char]=state
        local function connect(signal,fn)
            local connection=signal:Connect(fn)
            state.connections[#state.connections+1]=connection
        end
        local function changed() check(char,state) end
        for _,attribute in ipairs({"Health","Dead","LastKiller"}) do
            connect(char:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute),changed)
        end
        local function bindHumanoid(hum)
            if not hum:IsA("Humanoid") or state.hum then return end
            state.hum=hum
            if state.hp==nil then state.hp=health(char) end
            connect(hum.HealthChanged,changed)
            connect(hum.Died,changed)
        end
        local hum=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then bindHumanoid(hum) end
        connect(char.ChildAdded,bindHumanoid)
        if player then connect(player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LastKiller"),changed) end
        connect(char.AncestryChanged,function(_,parent)
            if not parent then
                for _,connection in ipairs(state.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
                state.connections={}
                pending[char]=nil
            end
        end)
        return state
    end
    function api.track(char,pos)
        if typeof(char)~="Instance" or not char:IsA("Model") or char==lp.Character then return end
        local player=services.players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
        local state=bindCharacter(char,player)
        state.lastPos=pos
        if not isDead(char) then pending[char]={at=os.clock()} end
        check(char,state)
    end
    function api.raycast(result)
        if type(result)~="table" or type(result.Hits)~="table" then return end
        for index=#result.Hits,1,-1 do
            local hit=result.Hits[index]
            local part=type(hit)=="table" and hit.Instance
            if typeof(part)=="Instance" then
                local char=part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                while char and not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and char:GetAttribute("Health")==nil do
                    char=char:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                end
                if char then api.track(char,hit.Position); return end
            end
        end
    end
    local function bindPlayer(player)
        if player==lp then return end
        runtime.connect(player.CharacterAdded,function(char) bindCharacter(char,player) end)
        if player.Character then bindCharacter(player.Character,player) end
    end
    for _,player in ipairs(services.players:GetPlayers()) do bindPlayer(player) end
    runtime.connect(services.players.PlayerAdded,bindPlayer)
    runtime.teardown(function()
        for _,state in pairs(states) do
            for _,connection in ipairs(state.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        end
        while #cards>0 do remove(cards[#cards]) end
    end)
    return api
end

-- Cosmetic-only Shitaro skin port. Original game catalog and asset IDs;
-- no shitaro.lol requests, external loader, purchase or inventory changes.
D.skinPort = function(services, api, runtime, window, library, cfgRegister, pageNameOf, knifeMode)
    local tabName=knifeMode and "Скины Knife" or "skin"
    local page = window:tab({name=tabName})
    pageNameOf[page] = tabName
    local skins = api.skins
    local chosen, catalog, byName, schemas = {}, {}, {}, {}
    local alive, applying, context = true, false, setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local mainThread={}
    local originalCamera = type(skins)=="table" and skins.GetCameraModel
    local selectedWeapon, selectedCard, renderWeapons, renderCards, refreshInspector
    local function make(class, props, parent) return library:create(class, props, parent) end
    local function label(parent, text, height)
        return make("TextLabel", {Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,height or 28), BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Text=text or "", TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(226,228,236), TextSize=13,
            Font=Enum.Font.Gotham, TextWrapped=true, TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, parent)
    end
    local function pretty(value)
        return (tostring(value or ""):gsub("_PATTERN_(%d+)", " #%1"):gsub("_", " "))
    end
    local function asset(value)
        if type(value)=="number" then return "rbxassetid://"..tostring(value) end
        if type(value)~="string" or value=="" then return nil end
        if value:match("^%d+$") then return "rbxassetid://"..value end
        return value
    end
    local function image(info, wear)
        if type(info)~="table" then return nil end
        if type(info.wearImages)=="table" and #info.wearImages>0 then
            if type(skins)=="table" and type(skins.GetWearImageForFloat)=="function" then
                local ok, result=pcall(skins.GetWearImageForFloat, info, wear or 0)
                if ok and asset(result) then return asset(result) end
            end
            local first=info.wearImages[1]
            if type(first)=="table" and asset(first.assetId) then return asset(first.assetId) end
        end
        return asset(info.imageAssetId)
    end
    local side="Обе команды"
    local function sideKeys()
        if side=="T" then return {"T Knife"} end
        if side=="CT" then return {"CT Knife"} end
        return {"T Knife","CT Knife"}
    end
    local function choice(name)
        if not knifeMode then return chosen[name] end
        if name=="T Knife" or name=="CT Knife" then return chosen[name] end
        if byName[name] then
            return chosen[services.lp:GetAttribute("Team")=="Counter-Terrorists" and "CT Knife" or "T Knife"]
        end
    end
    local function selectedChoice()
        return selectedWeapon and (knifeMode and chosen[sideKeys()[1]] or chosen[selectedWeapon.name])
    end
    local function allowed(name, props)
        if knifeMode then return type(props)=="table" and props.Class=="Melee" end
        if type(props)~="table" or props.Class~="Weapon" then return false end
        local subtype=tostring(props.SubType or props.WeaponType or ""):lower()
        return props.Type=="Pistol" or props.Type=="Rifle" or props.Type=="SMG"
            or props.Type=="Sniper" or props.Type=="SniperRifle" or subtype:find("sniper",1,true)~=nil
    end
    local function weaponGroup(name, props)
        if knifeMode then return "Ножи" end
        local key=tostring(name):lower():gsub("[%s%-%_]", "")
        local subtype=tostring(props.SubType or props.WeaponType or ""):lower()
        if props.Type=="Sniper" or props.Type=="SniperRifle" or subtype:find("sniper",1,true)
            or key=="awp" or key=="ssg08" or key=="scar20" or key=="g3sg1" or key=="scout" or key=="autosniper" then
            return "Снайперки"
        end
        return props.Type=="Pistol" and "Пистолеты" or "Автоматы"
    end
    local function rebuildCatalog()
        local list, index = {}, {}
        local db=services.storage:FindFirstChild("Database")
        local custom=db and db:FindFirstChild("Custom")
        local weapons=custom and custom:FindFirstChild("Weapons")
        if not weapons or type(skins)~="table" then catalog,byName=list,index; return end
        for _, mod in ipairs(weapons:GetChildren()) do
            if mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
                D.skinProperties=D.skinProperties or setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
                local props=D.skinProperties[mod]
                local ok=true
                if not props then ok,props=pcall(require,mod);if ok then D.skinProperties[mod]=props end end
                if ok and allowed(mod.Name,props) then
                    local rows=schemas[mod.Name]
                    if type(skins.GetAllSkinsForWeapon)=="function" then
                        local good, result=pcall(skins.GetAllSkinsForWeapon,mod.Name)
                        if good and type(result)=="table" then rows=result end
                    end
                    local finishes, stock, seen={},nil,{}
                    for _, info in pairs(type(rows)=="table" and rows or {}) do
                        if type(info)=="table" and type(info.skin)=="string" then
                            if info.skin=="Stock" then stock=info
                            elseif info.isEnabled and not seen[info.skin] then
                                seen[info.skin]=true; finishes[#finishes+1]=info
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    table.sort(finishes,function(a,b) return pretty(a.skin):lower()<pretty(b.skin):lower() end)
                    local cards={stock or {skin="Stock",rarity="Stock"}}
                    for _, info in ipairs(finishes) do cards[#cards+1]=info end
                    local entry={name=mod.Name, group=weaponGroup(mod.Name,props),
                        icon=image(stock or finishes[1],0) or asset(props.Icon) or asset(props.ReverseIcon), cards=cards}
                    list[#list+1]=entry; index[entry.name]=entry
                end
            end
        end
        table.sort(list,function(a,b) return a.name<b.name end)
        catalog,byName=list,index
    end
    local function current()
        local inv=api.inventory
        if type(inv)~="table" or type(inv.peekCurrentEquippedForMovement)~="function" then return end
        local ok, item=pcall(inv.peekCurrentEquippedForMovement)
        local vm=ok and type(item)=="table" and not item.IsDestroyed and item.Viewmodel
        if type(vm)=="table" and vm.Player==services.lp and typeof(vm.Model)=="Instance" then
            return vm, vm.CameraModelWeapon or vm.Weapon
        end
    end
    -- Same mesh/SurfaceAppearance transfer used by Shitaro for an already equipped gun.
    local function copyAppearance(source,target)
        for _, name in ipairs({"Weapon","WeaponL","WeaponR","Interactables"}) do
            local from, to=source:FindFirstChild(name),target:FindFirstChild(name)
            if from and to then
                local meshes={}
                for _, part in ipairs(from:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("MeshPart") then meshes[part.Name]=part end
                end
                for _, part in ipairs(to:GetDescendants()) do
                    local match=part:IsA("MeshPart") and meshes[part.Name]
                    if match then
                        local old=part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
                        local surface=match:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
                        if surface then surface:Clone().Parent=part end
                        part.TextureID=match.TextureID
                        if old then old:Destroy() end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local revision, lastModel, lastKey = 0,nil,nil
    local function refreshHeld(force)
        if applying or not alive or type(originalCamera)~="function" then return end
        local vm,name=current()
        if not vm then lastModel=nil; lastKey=nil; return end
        local state=choice(name)
        local key=tostring(name).."/"..tostring(revision)
        if not force and vm.Model==lastModel and key==lastKey then return end
        if not state and not byName[name] then lastModel=vm.Model;lastKey=key;return end
        applying=true
        local target=vm.Model
        -- A different knife needs the game's full rig/animation construction.
        -- The carry-over key changes so re-equipping cannot reuse the old rig.
        if knifeMode then
            lastModel=target;lastKey=key;applying=false;return
        end
        local ok, model=pcall(originalCamera,name,state and state.skin or vm.Skin,
            state and state.wear or vm.Float,state and state.stat and 0 or nil)
        local copied=false
        if ok and typeof(model)=="Instance" then
            local live=current()
            if live==vm and vm.Model==target and alive then
                copied=pcall(copyAppearance,model,target)
            end
            model:Destroy()
        end
        if copied then lastModel=target;lastKey=key end
        applying=false
    end
    -- Only override the local player's Viewmodel construction, never other players.
    if type(skins)=="table" and type(originalCamera)=="function" then
        runtime.field(skins,"GetCameraModel",function(original)
            return function(name,skin,...)
                local state=context[coroutine.running() or mainThread] and choice(name)
                if state then
                    local args=table.pack(...)
                    args[1],args[2]=state.wear,state.stat and 0 or nil
                    local model=original(state.model or name,state.skin,table.unpack(args,1,math.max(args.n,2)))
                    if model then return model end
                end
                return original(name,skin,...)
            end
        end)
    end
    local vmClass=api.viewmodel
    if type(vmClass)=="table" and type(vmClass.construct)=="function" then
        runtime.field(vmClass,"construct",function(original)
            return function(self,...)
                if self.Player~=services.lp or next(chosen)==nil then return original(self,...) end
                local thread=coroutine.running() or mainThread
                local before=context[thread]; context[thread]=true
                local result=table.pack(pcall(original,self,...))
                context[thread]=before
                if not result[1] then error(result[2],0) end
                return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
            end
        end)
    end
    -- A unique carry-over key prevents the game's cached model from keeping an old finish.
    if type(vmClass)=="table" and type(services.getups)=="function" and type(services.info)=="function" then
        for _, key in ipairs({"claim","new"}) do
            local fn=rawget(vmClass,key)
            if type(fn)=="function" then
                local ok,ups=pcall(services.getups,fn)
                if ok and type(ups)=="table" then
                    for slot,up in pairs(ups) do
                        if type(up)=="function" then
                            local good,name=pcall(services.info,up,"n")
                            if good and name=="getCarryOverKey" then
                                local original=up
                                runtime.upvalue(fn,slot,function(owner,weapon,a,...)
                                    local result=original(owner,weapon,a,...)
                                    local gun=type(owner)=="table" and (owner.ViewmodelCameraWeapon or weapon) or weapon
                                    local state=type(owner)=="table" and owner.Player==services.lp and choice(gun)
                                    if type(result)=="string" and state then
                                        result=result.."|skin/"..tostring(state.model).."/"..state.skin.."/"..tostring(state.wear).."/"..tostring(state.stat)
                                    end
                                    return result
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local left=page:section({name=tabName.." · выбор",side="left"})
    local right=page:section({name="Скины Shitaro",side="right"})
    page.holder,page._section=left.holder,left.native
    local status=label(left.holder,"Загрузка игрового каталога…",44)
    local group, query="Все",""
    local preview=make("ImageLabel",{Name="SkinPreview",Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,0,132),
        BackgroundTransparency=1,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,Image=""},left.holder)
    local title=label(left.holder,"Выбери оружие",40)
    local wear,stat=0,false
    local wearControl,statControl
    if knifeMode then
        page:dropdown({name="Команда",items={"Обе команды","T","CT"},default="Обе команды",callback=function(value)
            side=value;selectedCard=nil;if renderCards then renderCards() end
        end})
    end
    page:dropdown({name="Категория",items=(knifeMode and {"Все","Ножи"} or {"Все","Пистолеты","Автоматы","Снайперки"}),default="Все",callback=function(value)
        group=value;if renderWeapons then renderWeapons() end
    end})
    local searchRevision=0
    page:textbox({placeholder="Поиск оружия / скина",callback=function(value)
        query=tostring(value):lower();searchRevision=searchRevision+1
        local revision=searchRevision
        task.delay(0.15,function()
            if not alive or revision~=searchRevision then return end
            if renderWeapons then renderWeapons() end;if renderCards then renderCards() end
        end)
    end})
    wearControl=page:slider({name="Износ",min=0,max=100,interval=0.1,default=0,suffix="%",callback=function(value)
        if selectedCard then
            local range=selectedCard.floatRange or {}
            wear=math.clamp((tonumber(value) or 0)/100,tonumber(range.min) or 0,tonumber(range.max) or 0)
            if refreshInspector then refreshInspector() end
        end
    end})
    statControl=page:toggle({name="StatTrak",default=false,callback=function(value)
        stat=value==true and selectedCard~=nil and selectedCard.supportsStatTrak==true
        if value and not stat and statControl then statControl.set(false) end
    end})
    local function applySelected()
        if not selectedWeapon or not selectedCard then return end
        if knifeMode then
            for _,key in ipairs(sideKeys()) do
                chosen[key]={model=selectedWeapon.name,skin=selectedCard.skin,wear=wear,stat=stat}
            end
        elseif selectedCard.skin=="Stock" then chosen[selectedWeapon.name]=nil
        else chosen[selectedWeapon.name]={model=selectedWeapon.name,skin=selectedCard.skin,wear=wear,stat=stat} end
        revision=revision+1
        local ok,err=pcall(refreshHeld,true)
        if not ok then applying=false;warn("DaDa / skin: "..tostring(err)) end
        if refreshInspector then refreshInspector() end
    end
    page:button({name="Применить скин",callback=applySelected})
    page:button({name="Сбросить скин оружия",callback=function()
        if not selectedWeapon then return end
        if knifeMode then for _,key in ipairs(sideKeys()) do chosen[key]=nil end
        else chosen[selectedWeapon.name]=nil end
        revision=revision+1
        pcall(refreshHeld,true)
        if renderCards then renderCards() end
    end})
    local weaponHost=make("Frame",{Name="SkinWeapons",Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,0,170),BackgroundTransparency=1},left.holder)
    label(right.holder,"Скины · 2 столбца · листай колёсиком или свайпом",38)
    local cardHost=make("Frame",{Name="SkinCards",Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,0,360),
        BackgroundTransparency=1,ClipsDescendants=true},right.holder)
    local function scroll(parent)
        local host=make("ScrollingFrame",{Name="SkinScroll",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),
            BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,Active=true,ClipsDescendants=true,
            ScrollingEnabled=true,ScrollingDirection=Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
            ElasticBehavior=Enum.ElasticBehavior.WhenScrollable,
            ScrollBarThickness=6,ScrollBarImageColor3=Color3.fromRGB(120,148,194),
            ScrollBarImageTransparency=0.1,VerticalScrollBarInset=Enum.ScrollBarInset.Always,
            CanvasSize=UDim2.new(),AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y},parent)
        make("UIGridLayout",{CellSize=UDim2.new(0.5,-8,0,108),CellPadding=UDim2.fromOffset(8,8),
            FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,FillDirectionMaxCells=2,
            HorizontalAlignment=Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
            SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder},host)
        return host
    end
    local weaponsGrid,cardsGrid=scroll(weaponHost),scroll(cardHost)
    local function clear(host)
        for _,child in ipairs(host:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child:Destroy() end end
    end
    local cardButtons={}
    local function tile(host,name,subtitle,img,order,active,callback)
        local button=make("TextButton",{Name="SkinCard",Text="",LayoutOrder=order,BorderSizePixel=0,
            BackgroundColor3=active and Color3.fromRGB(43,56,78) or Color3.fromRGB(25,28,38)},host)
        button:SetAttribute("SkinCard",name)
        make("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,7)},button)
        make("ImageLabel",{Name="Image",Image=img or "",ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Size=UDim2.new(1,-10,1,-35),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(5,2)},button)
        make("TextLabel",{Text=name,BackgroundTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.new(0,5,1,-33),
            Size=UDim2.new(1,-10,0,17),TextSize=11,Font=Enum.Font.Gotham,
            TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(232,234,242)},button)
        make("TextLabel",{Text=subtitle or "",BackgroundTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.new(0,5,1,-16),
            Size=UDim2.new(1,-10,0,14),TextSize=10,Font=Enum.Font.Gotham,
            TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(153,160,178)},button)
        -- Owned by the button, not the global runtime registry; rebuilding cards frees handlers.
        button.Activated:Connect(callback)
        return button
    end
    refreshInspector=function()
        if not selectedWeapon or not selectedCard then preview.Image="";title.Text="Выбери оружие";return end
        preview.Image=image(selectedCard,wear) or selectedWeapon.icon or ""
        local state=selectedChoice()
        title.Text=selectedWeapon.name.." · "..pretty(selectedCard.skin)..
            ((state and state.model==selectedWeapon.name and state.skin==selectedCard.skin) and "\nПрименён" or "")
    end
    local function selectCard(info)
        selectedCard=info
        local state=selectedChoice()
        local range=info.floatRange or {}
        wear=math.clamp(state and state.model==selectedWeapon.name and state.skin==info.skin and state.wear or tonumber(range.min) or 0,
            tonumber(range.min) or 0,tonumber(range.max) or 0)
        stat=state and state.model==selectedWeapon.name and state.skin==info.skin and state.stat and info.supportsStatTrak==true or false
        wearControl.set(wear*100);statControl.set(stat);refreshInspector()
        for card,button in pairs(cardButtons) do
            button.BackgroundColor3=card==info and Color3.fromRGB(43,56,78) or Color3.fromRGB(25,28,38)
        end
    end
    renderCards=function()
        table.clear(cardButtons)
        clear(cardsGrid)
        if not selectedWeapon then return end
        local weapon=selectedWeapon
        local state=selectedChoice()
        if not selectedCard then
            local initial=weapon.cards[1]
            for _,info in ipairs(weapon.cards) do if state and state.model==weapon.name and state.skin==info.skin then initial=info;break end end
            selectCard(initial)
        end
        for order,info in ipairs(weapon.cards) do
            if query=="" or weapon.name:lower():find(query,1,true) or pretty(info.skin):lower():find(query,1,true) then
                local card=info
                cardButtons[card]=tile(cardsGrid,pretty(card.skin),tostring(card.rarity or "Stock"),image(card,(card.floatRange and tonumber(card.floatRange.min)) or 0) or weapon.icon,
                    order,selectedCard==card,function() selectCard(card) end)
            end
        end
        refreshInspector()
    end
    renderWeapons=function()
        clear(weaponsGrid)
        for order,entry in ipairs(catalog) do
            local matches=query=="" or entry.name:lower():find(query,1,true)
            if not matches then
                for _,info in ipairs(entry.cards) do if pretty(info.skin):lower():find(query,1,true) then matches=true;break end end
            end
            if (group=="Все" or group==entry.group) and matches then
                local weapon=entry
                tile(weaponsGrid,weapon.name,weapon.group,weapon.icon,order,selectedWeapon==weapon,function()
                    selectedWeapon,selectedCard=weapon,nil;renderWeapons();renderCards()
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    local function reload()
        local old=selectedWeapon and selectedWeapon.name
        rebuildCatalog()
        selectedWeapon,selectedCard=byName[old] or catalog[1],nil
        status.Text=#catalog>0 and ("Оружий: "..#catalog.." · картинки из игрового каталога")
            or "Каталог недоступен. Нужны модули оригинальной игры; затем нажми «Обновить каталог»."
        renderWeapons();renderCards();refreshInspector()
    end
    page:button({name="Обновить каталог",callback=function()
        local ok,err=pcall(reload)
        if not ok then status.Text="Ошибка каталога: "..tostring(err) end
    end})
    cfgRegister(page,"Loadout","skins",function()
        local result={}
        for name,state in pairs(chosen) do result[name]={model=state.model,skin=state.skin,wear=state.wear,stat=state.stat} end
        return result
    end,function(data)
        if type(data)~="table" then return end
        table.clear(chosen)
        for name,state in pairs(data) do
            local validKey=not knifeMode or name=="T Knife" or name=="CT Knife"
            local model=type(state)=="table" and (knifeMode and state.model or name)
            local entry=validKey and byName[model]
            if entry and type(state)=="table" then
                for _,info in ipairs(entry.cards) do
                    if state.skin==info.skin and (knifeMode or info.skin~="Stock") then
                        local range=info.floatRange or {}
                        chosen[name]={model=model,skin=info.skin,wear=math.clamp(tonumber(state.wear) or 0,
                            tonumber(range.min) or 0,tonumber(range.max) or 0),stat=state.stat==true and info.supportsStatTrak==true}
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        revision=revision+1;selectedCard=nil;renderCards();pcall(refreshHeld,true)
    end,nil)
    local ok,err=pcall(reload)
    if not ok then status.Text="Ошибка каталога: "..tostring(err) end
    if type(skins)=="table" and type(skins.ObserveItemStockSchemas)=="function" then
        local good,subscription=pcall(skins.ObserveItemStockSchemas,function(value)
            if not alive or type(value)~="table" then return end
            schemas=value
            local success,message=pcall(reload)
            if not success then warn("DaDa / skin catalog: "..tostring(message)) end
        end)
        if good then runtime.adopt(subscription) end
    end
    -- Mirror Shitaro's stock knife aliases; snapshot exact local values for reset.
    local inventoryData
    if knifeMode and type(api.data)=="table" and type(api.data.Get)=="function" and type(services.getups)=="function" then
        local ok,ups=pcall(services.getups,api.data.Get)
        if ok and type(ups)=="table" and type(ups[1])=="table" then inventoryData=ups[1] end
    end
    local snapshots=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local fields={"Name","Skin","Float","StatTrack","NameTag","Charm","Stickers"}
    local function restoreItem(item,snapshot)
        for _,field in ipairs(fields) do item[field]=snapshot[field] end
        snapshots[item]=nil
    end
    local function updateKnives()
        if not knifeMode then return end
        local data=inventoryData and inventoryData[services.lp]
        local items=data and data.Inventory
        if type(items)~="table" then return end
        for _,item in ipairs(items) do
            local key=type(item)=="table" and tostring(item._id):gsub("_Stock$", "")
            if key=="T Knife" or key=="CT Knife" then
                local state=chosen[key]
                if state then
                    if not snapshots[item] then
                        local snapshot={}
                        for _,field in ipairs(fields) do snapshot[field]=item[field] end
                        snapshots[item]=snapshot
                    end
                    item.Name,item.Skin,item.Float,item.StatTrack=state.model,state.skin,state.wear,state.stat and 0 or false
                elseif snapshots[item] then restoreItem(item,snapshots[item]) end
            end
        end
    end
    if knifeMode and type(runtime.detour)=="function" and type(services.newc)=="function" then
        if type(api.weapon_props)=="function" then
            local original
            original=runtime.detour(api.weapon_props,services.newc(function(name,...)
                local state=chosen[name]
                return original(state and state.model or name,...)
            end))
        end
        if type(api.skin_info)=="function" then
            local original
            original=runtime.detour(api.skin_info,services.newc(function(item,...)
                local key=type(item)=="table" and tostring(item._id):gsub("_Stock$", "")
                local state=key and chosen[key]
                if state then
                    item=table.clone(item)
                    item.Name,item.Skin,item.Float,item.StatTrack=state.model,state.skin,state.wear,state.stat and 0 or false
                end
                return original(item,...)
            end))
        end
    end
    if knifeMode then label(left.holder,"После смены модели убери нож и достань снова. Stock — стандартная отделка выбранной модели; сброс возвращает штатный нож.",60) end
    local elapsed=0
    runtime.connect(services.run.Heartbeat,function(dt)
        elapsed=elapsed+dt
        if elapsed<0.3 then return end
        elapsed=0
        updateKnives()
        local good,message=pcall(refreshHeld,false)
        if not good then applying=false;warn("DaDa / skin refresh: "..tostring(message)) end
    end)
    runtime.teardown(function()
        -- Registered after hooks: restore the held gun before hooks are removed.
        table.clear(chosen);revision=revision+1
        for item,snapshot in pairs(snapshots) do restoreItem(item,snapshot) end
        pcall(refreshHeld,true)
        alive=false
    end)
    return page
end

local runtime = D.load("a")
runtime.takeover()
-- BEGIN DADA MUSIC PORT FROM MM2 (UI/audio only)
D.installMusicUI = function(runtime, Win, gui, main)
    local failedCleanup
    local function installDaDaMusic()
        local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
        local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
        local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
        local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
        local environment = (type(getgenv)=="function" and getgenv()) or _G
        local CrackHubEnvironment = {
            isfile=environment.isfile or isfile, isfolder=environment.isfolder or isfolder,
            makefolder=environment.makefolder or makefolder, writefile=environment.writefile or writefile,
            readfile=environment.readfile or readfile,
            getcustomasset=environment.getcustomasset or environment.getsynasset or getcustomasset or getsynasset,
        }
        local isfile, isfolder = CrackHubEnvironment.isfile, CrackHubEnvironment.isfolder
        local makefolder, writefile, readfile = CrackHubEnvironment.makefolder, CrackHubEnvironment.writefile, CrackHubEnvironment.readfile
        local Theme = {
            Background=Color3.fromRGB(18,20,29), Element=Color3.fromRGB(28,31,45),
            ElementHover=Color3.fromRGB(40,45,62), Stroke=Color3.fromRGB(58,70,98),
            Text=Color3.fromRGB(226,228,236), SubText=Color3.fromRGB(112,116,138),
            Accent=Color3.fromRGB(78,139,255), Danger=Color3.fromRGB(255,69,58),
        }
        pcall(function() Theme.Accent=Win:GetCustomization().accentColor or Theme.Accent end)
        local bridgeAlive, bridgeConnections, themedObjects = true, {}, {}
        local ownedObjects = {}
        -- Track even the Sound created directly by the untouched music module.
        local NativeInstance=Instance
        local Instance={new=function(class,parent)
            local object=NativeInstance.new(class,parent)
            table.insert(ownedObjects,object)
            return object
        end}
        local function connect(signal, callback)
            local connection=signal:Connect(function(...) if bridgeAlive then return callback(...) end end)
            table.insert(bridgeConnections,connection)
            return connection
        end
        local function Create(class, properties, children)
            local object=Instance.new(class)
            for property,value in pairs(properties or {}) do
                if property~="Parent" then
                    object[property]=value
                    if typeof(value)=="Color3" then
                        for key,color in pairs(Theme) do
                            if value==color then table.insert(themedObjects,{Object=object,Property=property,Key=key});break end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for _,child in ipairs(children or {}) do child.Parent=object end
            if properties and properties.Parent then object.Parent=properties.Parent end
            return object
        end
        local function Corner(radius) return Create("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,radius or 7)}) end
        local function Stroke(color,thickness,transparency)
            return Create("UIStroke",{Color=color or Theme.Stroke,Thickness=thickness or 1,Transparency=transparency or 0,ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border})
        end
        local function List(padding)
            return Create("UIListLayout",{Padding=UDim.new(0,padding or 6),SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder})
        end
        local order=0
        local function NextOrder() order=order+1;return order end
        local function Tween(object,properties,duration,style,direction)
            local tween=TweenService:Create(object,TweenInfo.new(duration or .15,style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,direction or Enum.EasingDirection.Out),properties)
            tween:Play();return tween
        end
        local function MakeDraggable(handle,frame,connections)
            local inputDown,origin,startPosition
            local function bind(signal,fn)
                local c=signal:Connect(fn);table.insert(connections,c)
            end
            bind(handle.InputBegan,function(input)
                if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    inputDown=input;origin=input.Position;startPosition=frame.Position
                end
            end)
            bind(UserInputService.InputChanged,function(input)
                if not inputDown or not frame.Parent then return end
                if input~=inputDown and input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
                if inputDown.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input~=inputDown then return end
                local delta=input.Position-origin
                frame.Position=UDim2.new(startPosition.X.Scale,startPosition.X.Offset+delta.X,startPosition.Y.Scale,startPosition.Y.Offset+delta.Y)
            end)
            bind(UserInputService.InputEnded,function(input)
                if input==inputDown or (inputDown and inputDown.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then inputDown=nil end
            end)
        end
        -- Kept for compatibility with the supplied module's optional embedded assets.
        local function Base64Decode(data)
            local alphabet="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
            local lookup={};for i=1,#alphabet do lookup[alphabet:sub(i,i)]=i-1 end
            local result,buffer,bits={},0,0
            for char in tostring(data):gmatch(".") do
                local value=lookup[char]
                if value then
                    buffer=buffer*64+value;bits=bits+6
                    if bits>=8 then bits=bits-8;local divisor=2^bits;result[#result+1]=string.char(math.floor(buffer/divisor)%256);buffer=buffer%divisor end
                end
            end
            return table.concat(result)
        end

            return Create("TextLabel",{BackgroundTransparency=1,Size=size or UDim2.new(1,-22,1,0),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,0),

        end

                {Create("UIPadding",{PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,10),PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,10),PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,4),PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,2)})})

        end
        function Container:AddToggle(options)
            local frame=row(self,options.Name,36)
            label(frame,options.Name,UDim2.new(1,-66,1,0))
            local switch=Create("TextButton",{Name="Switch",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,-10,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(32,18),
                BackgroundColor3=Theme.ElementHover,BorderSizePixel=0,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,Parent=frame},{Corner(9)})
            local dot=Create("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,.5),Position=UDim2.new(0,3,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(12,12),BorderSizePixel=0,BackgroundColor3=Theme.Text,Parent=switch},{Corner(6)})
            local hit=Create("TextButton",{Name="ToggleHit",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",Parent=frame})
            local value=options.Default==true
            local object={Frame=frame}
            local function paint()
                switch.BackgroundColor3=value and Theme.Accent or Theme.ElementHover
                dot.Position=value and UDim2.new(1,-15,.5,0) or UDim2.new(0,3,.5,0)
            end
            function object:Get() return value end
            function object:Set(v,quiet) value=v==true;paint();if not quiet and options.Callback then options.Callback(value) end end
            connect(hit.Activated,function() object:Set(not value) end)
            paint();return object
        end
        function Container:AddSlider(options)
            local frame=row(self,options.Name,54)
            label(frame,options.Name,UDim2.new(1,-85,0,25))
            local number=label(frame,"",UDim2.new(0,70,0,25));number.Position=UDim2.new(1,-80,0,0);number.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
            local area=Create("TextButton",{Name="SliderHit",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,26),Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,24),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",Active=true,Parent=frame})
            local track=Create("Frame",{Position=UDim2.new(0,0,.5,-2),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,4),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Stroke,BorderSizePixel=0,Parent=area},{Corner(2)})
            local fill=Create("Frame",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,1),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent,BorderSizePixel=0,Parent=track},{Corner(2)})
            local knob=Create("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0,.5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(10,10),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Text,BorderSizePixel=0,Parent=track},{Corner(5)})
            local minimum,maximum=options.Min or 0,options.Max or 100
            local increment=options.Increment or 1
            local value=math.clamp(tonumber(options.Default) or minimum,minimum,maximum)
            local active
            local object={Frame=frame}
            local function paint()
                local fraction=maximum>minimum and (value-minimum)/(maximum-minimum) or 0
                fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(fraction,1);knob.Position=UDim2.fromScale(fraction,.5)
                number.Text=tostring(value)..(options.Suffix or "")
            end
            function object:Get() return value end
            function object:Set(v,quiet)
                v=tonumber(v) or minimum
                if increment>0 then v=minimum+math.floor((v-minimum)/increment+.5)*increment end
                value=math.clamp(v,minimum,maximum);paint()
                if not quiet and options.Callback then options.Callback(value) end
            end
            local function setAt(input)
                if track.AbsoluteSize.X>0 then object:Set(minimum+math.clamp((input.Position.X-track.AbsolutePosition.X)/track.AbsoluteSize.X,0,1)*(maximum-minimum)) end
            end
            connect(area.InputBegan,function(input)
                if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then active=input;setAt(input) end
            end)
            connect(UserInputService.InputChanged,function(input)
                if active and (input==active or (active.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement)) then setAt(input) end
            end)
            connect(UserInputService.InputEnded,function(input)
                if active and (input==active or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then active=nil end
            end)
            paint();return object
        end
        function Container:AddDropdown(options)
            local frame=row(self,options.Name,36)
            local button=Create("TextButton",{Name="Selection",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",Font=Enum.Font.BuilderSansMedium,

            local list=Create("Frame",{Name="Options",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,36),Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,0,0),BackgroundTransparency=1,Visible=false,Parent=frame},{List(2)})
            local value=options.Default or (options.Options or {})[1]
            local expanded=false
            local object={Frame=frame}
            local function paint() button.Text=tostring(options.Name)..": "..tostring(value or "").."  ▾" end
            local function show(state)
                expanded=state;local height=state and #(options.Options or {})*28 or 0
                list.Visible=state;list.Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,0,height);frame.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,36+height)
                button.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,36)
            end
            function object:Get() return value end
            function object:Set(v,quiet) value=v;paint();if not quiet and options.Callback then options.Callback(value) end end
            for index,choice in ipairs(options.Options or {}) do
                local item=Create("TextButton",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,26),BackgroundColor3=Theme.ElementHover,BorderSizePixel=0,Text=tostring(choice),TextColor3=Theme.Text,
                    TextSize=12,Font=Enum.Font.BuilderSansMedium,LayoutOrder=index,Parent=list},{Corner(5)})
                connect(item.Activated,function() show(false);object:Set(choice) end)
            end
            connect(button.Activated,function() show(not expanded) end)
            paint();return object
        end
        function Container:AddButton(options)
            local frame=row(self,options.Name,34)
            local button=Create("TextButton",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=options.Name or "Button",TextColor3=Theme.Text,

        end
        local window={Gui=gui,Main=main,Visible=main.Visible}

        function tab:AddGroup(title)
            local section=nativeTab:AddSection(title,"left")
            if not fullColumn then
                fullColumn=section.frame.Parent
                local index=fullColumn:GetAttribute("TabIndex")
                for _,child in ipairs(fullColumn.Parent:GetChildren()) do
                    if child~=fullColumn and child:IsA("ScrollingFrame") and child:GetAttribute("TabIndex")==index then emptyColumn=child;break end
                end
                fullColumn.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
                if emptyColumn then
                    emptyColumn.Visible=false;emptyColumn.Size=UDim2.new(0,0,1,0)
                    connect(emptyColumn:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"),function() if emptyColumn.Visible then emptyColumn.Visible=false end end)
                end
            end
            local holder=Create("Frame",{Name="DaDaMusicGroup",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,BackgroundTransparency=1},
                {List(6),Create("UIPadding",{PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,8),PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,8),PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,8),PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,8)})})
