    -- world: fullbright / no fog / camera fov (restores originals on disable)
    local lighting = services.lighting
    local atmosphere = lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
    local orig = {
        Brightness=lighting.Brightness, ClockTime=lighting.ClockTime, GlobalShadows=lighting.GlobalShadows,
        Ambient=lighting.Ambient, OutdoorAmbient=lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
        FogEnd=lighting.FogEnd, FogStart=lighting.FogStart,
        Density=atmosphere and atmosphere.Density or nil,
        FogColor=lighting.FogColor, Exposure=lighting.ExposureCompensation,
    }
    local function restoreBright()
        pcall(function()
            lighting.Brightness, lighting.ClockTime, lighting.GlobalShadows = orig.Brightness, orig.ClockTime, orig.GlobalShadows
            lighting.Ambient, lighting.OutdoorAmbient = orig.Ambient, orig.OutdoorAmbient
        end)
    end
    local function restoreFog()
        pcall(function()
            lighting.FogEnd, lighting.FogStart = orig.FogEnd, orig.FogStart
            if atmosphere and orig.Density then atmosphere.Density = orig.Density end
        end)
    end


    -- ===== world / post-processing (all restored on disable / unload) =====
    local wd = {
        time=false, timeVal=12,
        fog=false, fogStart=0, fogEnd=500, fogCol=Color3.fromRGB(192,192,205),
        ambient=false, ambCol=Color3.fromRGB(130,130,150),
        fbPower=200, noShadows=false,
        exposure=false, expVal=0,
        bloom=false, bloomInt=1, bloomSize=24, bloomThr=2,
        cc=false, ccSat=0, ccBri=0, ccCon=0, ccTint=Color3.new(1,1,1),
        sun=false, sunInt=0.25,
        atmo=false, atmoDensity=0.3,
    }
    local wState, wfx = {}, {}
    local function wfxGet(class, name)
        local e = wfx[name]
        if e and e.Parent then return e end
        e = Instance.new(class)
        e.Name = name
        e.Parent = lighting
        wfx[name] = e
        return e
    end
    local function wprop(key, on, obj, prop, value, restore)
        if on then
            obj[prop] = value
            wState[key] = true
        elseif wState[key] then
            if restore ~= nil then obj[prop] = restore end
            wState[key] = nil
        end
    end
    local function worldStep()
        wprop("time", wd.time, lighting, "ClockTime", wd.timeVal, orig.ClockTime)
        wprop("fogS", wd.fog, lighting, "FogStart", wd.fogStart, orig.FogStart)
        wprop("fogE", wd.fog, lighting, "FogEnd", math.max(wd.fogEnd, wd.fogStart + 1), orig.FogEnd)
        wprop("fogC", wd.fog, lighting, "FogColor", wd.fogCol, orig.FogColor)
        wprop("amb", wd.ambient, lighting, "Ambient", wd.ambCol, orig.Ambient)
        wprop("ambO", wd.ambient, lighting, "OutdoorAmbient", wd.ambCol, orig.OutdoorAmbient)
        wprop("shadow", wd.noShadows, lighting, "GlobalShadows", false, orig.GlobalShadows)
        wprop("exp", wd.exposure, lighting, "ExposureCompensation", wd.expVal, orig.Exposure)
        if atmosphere then
            wprop("atmo", wd.atmo, atmosphere, "Density", wd.atmoDensity, orig.Density)
        end
        if wd.bloom then
            local e = wfxGet("BloomEffect", "DaDaBloom")
            e.Enabled, e.Intensity, e.Size, e.Threshold = true, wd.bloomInt, wd.bloomSize, wd.bloomThr
        elseif wfx.DaDaBloom then
            wfx.DaDaBloom.Enabled = false
        end
        if wd.cc then
            local e = wfxGet("ColorCorrectionEffect", "DaDaCC")
            e.Enabled = true
            e.Saturation, e.Brightness, e.Contrast = wd.ccSat/100, wd.ccBri/100, wd.ccCon/100
            e.TintColor = wd.ccTint
        elseif wfx.DaDaCC then
            wfx.DaDaCC.Enabled = false
        end
        if wd.sun then
            local e = wfxGet("SunRaysEffect", "DaDaSun")
            e.Enabled, e.Intensity = true, wd.sunInt
        elseif wfx.DaDaSun then
            wfx.DaDaSun.Enabled = false
        end
    end
    local function restoreWorld()
        for k,v in pairs(wd) do
            if v == true then wd[k] = false end
        end
        pcall(worldStep)
        for _,e in pairs(wfx) do pcall(function() e:Destroy() end) end
        wfx = {}
    end

    -- ===== players helpers =====
    local lp = services.players.LocalPlayer
    local green = Color3.fromRGB(114,188,143)
    local function allyOf(p)
        return esp.shSet.useTeam and lp.Team ~= nil and p.Team == lp.Team
    end
    local function shown(p)
        if p == lp then return false end
        if allyOf(p) and not friendly.en then return false end
        return true
    end
    local function charParts(p)
        local ch = p.Character
        if not ch then return nil end
        local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then return nil end
        return ch, hum, root
    end

    -- ===== chams =====
    local highlights = {}
    local function clearChams()
        for p,h in pairs(highlights) do
            pcall(function() h:Destroy() end)
            highlights[p] = nil
        end
    end
    local function updateChams()
        if not vis.chams then
            if next(highlights) then clearChams() end
            return
        end
        for _,p in ipairs(services.players:GetPlayers()) do
            local ch = nil
            if shown(p) then ch = charParts(p) end
            local h = highlights[p]
            if ch then
                if not h or not h.Parent then
                    h = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    h.Parent = fxFolder
                    highlights[p] = h
                end
                local ally = allyOf(p)
                h.Adornee = ch
                h.FillColor = ally and green or pickColor(vis.chamsColor)
                h.OutlineColor = ally and green or pickColor(vis.chamsOutCol)
                h.FillTransparency = vis.chamsFill
                h.OutlineTransparency = vis.chamsOutline
                h.DepthMode = vis.chamsWall and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
                h.Enabled = true
            elseif h then
                pcall(function() h:Destroy() end)
                highlights[p] = nil
            end
        end
        for p,h in pairs(highlights) do
            if not p.Parent then
                pcall(function() h:Destroy() end)
                highlights[p] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    -- ===== snaplines / skeleton =====
    local immediate = painter.immediate
    local linePool, lineUsed = {}, 0
    local function line(a, b, col, th)
        if immediate then
            painter.line(a, b, col, 1, th)
            return
        end
        lineUsed = lineUsed + 1
        local l = linePool[lineUsed]
        if not l then
            l = Drawing.new("Line")
            linePool[lineUsed] = l
        end
        l.From, l.To, l.Color, l.Thickness, l.Transparency, l.Visible = a, b, col, th, 1, true
    end
    local function hideLines()
        for i = lineUsed + 1, #linePool do linePool[i].Visible = false end
    end
    local function removeLines()
        for i,l in ipairs(linePool) do
            pcall(function() l:Remove() end)
            linePool[i] = nil
        end
    end
    local R15 = {
        {"Head","UpperTorso"},{"UpperTorso","LowerTorso"},
        {"UpperTorso","LeftUpperArm"},{"LeftUpperArm","LeftLowerArm"},{"LeftLowerArm","LeftHand"},
        {"UpperTorso","RightUpperArm"},{"RightUpperArm","RightLowerArm"},{"RightLowerArm","RightHand"},
        {"LowerTorso","LeftUpperLeg"},{"LeftUpperLeg","LeftLowerLeg"},{"LeftLowerLeg","LeftFoot"},
        {"LowerTorso","RightUpperLeg"},{"RightUpperLeg","RightLowerLeg"},{"RightLowerLeg","RightFoot"},
    }
    local R6 = {{"Head","Torso"},{"Torso","Left Arm"},{"Torso","Right Arm"},{"Torso","Left Leg"},{"Torso","Right Leg"}}
    local function drawLines()
        local cam = services.workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam or not (vis.snap or vis.skel) then return end
        local v = cam.ViewportSize
        local origin
        if vis.snapOrigin == 1 then origin = Vector2.new(v.X/2, v.Y)
        elseif vis.snapOrigin == 2 then origin = Vector2.new(v.X/2, v.Y/2)
        else origin = Vector2.new(v.X/2, 0) end
        for _,p in ipairs(services.players:GetPlayers()) do
            if shown(p) then
                local ch, hum, root = charParts(p)
                if ch then
                    local col = allyOf(p) and green or pickColor(vis.lineColor)
                    if vis.snap then
                        local pt, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
                        if on then line(origin, Vector2.new(pt.X, pt.Y), col, vis.lineThick) end
                    end
                    if vis.skel then
                        local set = ch:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") and R15 or R6
                        for _,pair in ipairs(set) do
                            local a, b = ch:FindFirstChild(pair[1]), ch:FindFirstChild(pair[2])
                            if a and b then
                                local pa, oa = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(a.Position)
                                local pb, ob = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(b.Position)
                                if oa and ob then
                                    line(Vector2.new(pa.X, pa.Y), Vector2.new(pb.X, pb.Y), col, vis.lineThick)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if immediate then
        local okc, conn = pcall(function()
            return DrawingImmediate.GetPaint(0):Connect(function() pcall(drawLines) end)
        end)
        if okc and conn then runtime.adopt(conn) end
    end

    -- ===== radar =====
    local radar = make("Frame", {
        Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,138), Size=UDim2.fromOffset(vis.radarSize, vis.radarSize),
        BackgroundColor3=C.bg, BackgroundTransparency=0.18, BorderSizePixel=0, Visible=false, Active=false,
    }, gui)
    corner(radar, 9999); stroke(radar, C.stroke, 1)
    make("Frame", {AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5), Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5),
        Size=UDim2.new(1,-14,0,1), BackgroundColor3=C.stroke, BorderSizePixel=0}, radar)
    make("Frame", {AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5), Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5),
        Size=UDim2.new(0,1,1,-14), BackgroundColor3=C.stroke, BorderSizePixel=0}, radar)
    make("Frame", {AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5), Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5),
        Size=UDim2.fromOffset(8,8), BackgroundColor3=accent, Rotation=45, BorderSizePixel=0}, radar)
    local radarDots = {}
    for i=1,40 do
        radarDots[i] = make("Frame", {AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5), Size=UDim2.fromOffset(7,7),
            BorderSizePixel=0, Visible=false}, radar)
        corner(radarDots[i], 4)
    end
    local function updateRadar()
        radar.Visible = vis.radar
        if not vis.radar then return end
        local size = vis.radarSize
        radar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
        local cam = services.workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        local cf = cam.CFrame
        local rv = Vector3.new(cf.RightVector.X, 0, cf.RightVector.Z)
        local fv = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
        if rv.Magnitude < 1e-3 or fv.Magnitude < 1e-3 then return end
        rv, fv = rv.Unit, fv.Unit
        local half = size/2 - 6
        local myRoot = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local myPos = myRoot and myRoot.Position or cf.Position
        local n = 0
        for _,p in ipairs(services.players:GetPlayers()) do
            if n < #radarDots and shown(p) then
                local ch, hum, root = charParts(p)
                if ch then
                    local d = root.Position - myPos
                    local x = d:Dot(rv) / vis.radarRange * half
                    local y = -d:Dot(fv) / vis.radarRange * half
                    local mag = math.sqrt(x*x + y*y)
                    local edge = false
                    if mag > half then x, y, edge = x/mag*half, y/mag*half, true end
                    n = n + 1
                    local dot = radarDots[n]
                    dot.Visible = true
                    dot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x, 0.5, y)
                    dot.BackgroundColor3 = allyOf(p) and green or C.red
                    dot.BackgroundTransparency = edge and 0.55 or 0
                end
            end
        end
        for i = n+1, #radarDots do radarDots[i].Visible = false end
    end

    -- ===== player list =====
    local plist = make("Frame", {
        AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0), Position=UDim2.new(1,-14,0,46), Size=UDim2.fromOffset(224,30),
        BackgroundColor3=C.bg, BackgroundTransparency=0.15, BorderSizePixel=0, Visible=false, Active=false,
    }, gui)
    corner(plist, 10); stroke(plist, C.stroke, 1)
    label(plist, "ИГРОКИ", UDim2.fromOffset(12,6), UDim2.fromOffset(120,16), 10, C.dim, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
    local plRows = {}
    for i=1,8 do
        local nm = label(plist, "", UDim2.fromOffset(12, 22+(i-1)*19), UDim2.fromOffset(112,18), 12, C.text, Enum.Font.GothamMedium)
        nm.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        local st = label(plist, "", UDim2.fromOffset(112, 22+(i-1)*19), UDim2.fromOffset(100,18), 12, C.text, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
        st.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
        plRows[i] = {nm, st}
    end
    local function updateList()
        plist.Visible = vis.plist
        if not vis.plist then return end
        local myRoot = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local myPos = myRoot and myRoot.Position or Vector3.new()
        local rows = {}
        for _,p in ipairs(services.players:GetPlayers()) do
            if shown(p) then
                local ch, hum, root = charParts(p)
                if ch then
                    rows[#rows+1] = {p=p, dist=(root.Position-myPos).Magnitude, hp=hum.Health, max=math.max(hum.MaxHealth,1)}
                end
            end
        end
        table.sort(rows, function(a,b) return a.dist < b.dist end)
        for i=1,#plRows do
            local r, ui = rows[i], plRows[i]
            if r then
                ui[1].Text = r.p.Name
                ui[1].TextColor3 = allyOf(r.p) and green or C.text
                ui[2].Text = string.format("%dм · %d", math.floor(r.dist+0.5), math.floor(r.hp+0.5))
                local f = math.clamp(r.hp / r.max, 0, 1)
                ui[2].TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(233,95,102):Lerp(green, f)
                ui[1].Visible, ui[2].Visible = true, true
            else
                ui[1].Visible, ui[2].Visible = false, false
            end
        end
        plist.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(224, 30 + math.min(#rows,#plRows)*19)
    end

    -- ===== sounds / kill effects =====
    local soundList = {
        {1,"Пинг","rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"},
        {2,"Щелчок","rbxasset://sounds/snap.mp3"},
        {3,"Бас","rbxasset://sounds/bass.mp3"},
        {4,"Клик","rbxasset://sounds/clickfast.wav"},
        {5,"Уф","rbxasset://sounds/uuhhh.mp3"},
        {6,"Splat","rbxasset://sounds/splat.wav"},
    }
    local soundOptions = {}
    for i,s in ipairs(soundList) do soundOptions[i] = {i, s[2]} end
    -- Generate short local PCM tones where custom local assets are supported.
    -- This avoids relying on missing/deleted public audio IDs.
    local soundCache, soundWarned = {}, false
    local function soundAsset(idx)
        if soundCache[idx] then return soundCache[idx] end
        local entry=soundList[idx] or soundList[1]
        local fallback="rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"
        local writer=writefile
        local asset=getcustomasset or getsynasset
        if type(writer)=="function" and type(asset)=="function" then
            local ok,uri=pcall(function()
                local rate,duration=22050,0.13
                local count=math.floor(rate*duration)
                local data={}
                local frequency=({1320,2100,180,900,440,660})[idx] or 1320
                for n=0,count-1 do
                    local t=n/rate
                    local envelope=math.min(t/0.003,1)*math.exp(-t*34)
                    local sample=math.sin(2*math.pi*frequency*t)
                    if idx==2 then sample=sample+0.35*math.sin(2*math.pi*3700*t) end
                    if idx==5 then sample=math.sin(2*math.pi*(660*t-1200*t*t)) end
                    if idx==6 then sample=sample*math.sin(2*math.pi*93*t) end
                    local value=math.floor(math.clamp(sample*envelope,-1,1)*26000)
                    if value<0 then value=value+65536 end
                    data[#data+1]=string.char(value%256,math.floor(value/256)%256)
                end
                local function le16(n) return string.char(n%256,math.floor(n/256)%256) end
                local function le32(n) return le16(n%65536)..le16(math.floor(n/65536)) end
                local pcm=table.concat(data)
                local wav="RIFF"..le32(36+#pcm).."WAVEfmt "..le32(16)..le16(1)..le16(1)
                    ..le32(rate)..le32(rate*2)..le16(2)..le16(16).."data"..le32(#pcm)..pcm
                local path="DaDa_feedback_"..tostring(idx)..".wav"
                writer(path,wav)
                return asset(path)
            end)
            if ok and type(uri)=="string" and uri~="" then
                soundCache[idx]=uri
                return uri
            end
        end
        soundCache[idx]=entry and entry[3] or fallback
        return soundCache[idx]
    end
    local function playSound(idx, vol, pitch)
        idx=math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(idx) or 1),1,#soundList)
        local sound=Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.Name="DaDaFeedback"
        sound.SoundId=soundAsset(idx)
        sound.Volume=math.clamp(tonumber(vol) or 1,0,5)
        sound.PlaybackSpeed=math.clamp(tonumber(pitch) or 1,0.5,2)
        sound.Parent=services.sounds
        services.debris:AddItem(sound,8)
        runtime.spawn(function()
            local loaded=false
            local ready=sound.Loaded:Connect(function() loaded=true end)
            local ok,err=pcall(function()
                sound:Play()
                local deadline=os.clock()+1.2
                repeat
                    task.wait(0.04)
                until not sound.Parent or sound.IsLoaded or loaded or os.clock()>=deadline
                if sound.Parent and not sound.IsLoaded and not loaded then
                    sound.SoundId="rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"
                    sound:Play()
                    task.wait(0.5)
                    if not sound.IsLoaded and not soundWarned then
                        soundWarned=true
                        warn("DaDa: audio asset unavailable; check Roblox volume and local asset support")
                    end
                end
            end)
            ready:Disconnect()
            if not ok and not soundWarned then
                soundWarned=true
                warn("DaDa feedback: "..tostring(err))
            end
        end)
    end
    local function newFxPart(pos, size, shape)
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        if shape then p.Shape = shape end
        p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
        p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        p.Color = pickColor(vis.killColor)
        p.Size = size
        p.Position = pos
        p.Parent = fxFolder
        return p
    end
    local function killBurst(pos)
        for i=1,16 do
            local p = newFxPart(pos, Vector3.new(0.4,0.4,0.4), Enum.PartType.Ball)
            local dir = Vector3.new(math.random()-0.5, math.random()*0.8+0.1, math.random()-0.5).Unit
            tween(p, {Position=pos + dir*(5+math.random()*5), Transparency=1, Size=Vector3.new(0.1,0.1,0.1)}, 0.75)
            services.debris:AddItem(p, 0.9)
        end
        local core = newFxPart(pos, Vector3.new(1,1,1), Enum.PartType.Ball)
        tween(core, {Size=Vector3.new(7,7,7), Transparency=1}, 0.5)
        services.debris:AddItem(core, 0.7)
    end
    local function killRing(pos)
        for i=1,2 do
            local p = newFxPart(pos - Vector3.new(0,2.5,0), Vector3.new(0.2,1,1), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
            p.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos - Vector3.new(0,2.5,0)) * CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2)
            p.Transparency = 0.1
            tween(p, {Size=Vector3.new(0.2,10+i*5,10+i*5), Transparency=1}, 0.5+i*0.25)
            services.debris:AddItem(p, 1.2)
        end
        local beam = newFxPart(pos + Vector3.new(0,4,0), Vector3.new(0.3,14,0.3))
        tween(beam, {Size=Vector3.new(0.05,14,0.05), Transparency=1}, 0.8)
        services.debris:AddItem(beam, 1)
    end
    local function killText(pos)
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
        p.Transparency = 1
        p.Size = Vector3.new(0.2,0.2,0.2)
        p.Position = pos + Vector3.new(0,2,0)
        p.Parent = fxFolder
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120,40)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.Parent = p
        local t = make("TextLabel", {
            Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1), BackgroundTransparency=1, Text="KILL",
            Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize=30, TextColor3=pickColor(vis.killColor),
            TextStrokeTransparency=0.3, TextStrokeColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0),
        }, bb)
        tween(p, {Position=pos + Vector3.new(0,5,0)}, 1.1)
        tween(t, {TextTransparency=1, TextStrokeTransparency=1}, 1.1)
        services.debris:AddItem(p, 1.3)
    end
    local feedback = D.dadaFeedback(runtime,services,vis,playSound,function(pos)
        if vis.killStyle == 1 then killBurst(pos) else killRing(pos) end
        killText(pos)
    end)

    -- ===== third person =====
    local tpOrig, tpApplied, tpParts, tpPartsT = nil, nil, {}, 0
    local function tpUndo()
        local cam = services.workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam and tpApplied and tpOrig and cam.CFrame == tpApplied then cam.CFrame = tpOrig end
        tpApplied = nil
    end
    local function tpApply()
        if not vis.tp then return end
        local cam = services.workspace.CurrentCamera
        local ch = lp.Character
        local head = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not cam or not head then return end
        local cf = cam.CFrame
        tpOrig = cf
        local from = cf.Position
        local target = from - cf.LookVector*vis.tpDist + cf.UpVector*vis.tpHeight + cf.RightVector*vis.tpShoulder
        if vis.tpColl then
            local params = RaycastParams.new()
            params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {ch, fxFolder, cam}
            params.RespectCanCollide = true
            local dir = target - from
            local r = services.workspace:Raycast(from, dir, params)
            if r then target = from + dir.Unit * math.max(r.Distance - 0.7, 0.3) end
        end
        cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(target) * cf.Rotation
        tpApplied = cam.CFrame
        if vis.tpBody then
            local now = os.clock()
            if now - tpPartsT > 1 then
                tpPartsT = now
                tpParts = {}
                for _,d in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("BasePart") then tpParts[#tpParts+1] = d end
                end
            end
            for _,pt in ipairs(tpParts) do pcall(function() pt.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0 end) end
        end
    end
    local function fxCleanup()
        vis.chams, vis.tp = false, false
        clearChams()
        removeLines()
        tpUndo()
    end

    local lastTracerAt, fpsAvg, infoTimer, listTimer = 0, 60, 0, 0
    local function muzzle(origin, cam)
        local cf = cam.CFrame
        if (origin - cf.Position).Magnitude < 4 then
            return origin + cf.RightVector*0.7 - cf.UpVector*0.45 + cf.LookVector*1.2
        end
        return origin
    end
    aim.on_shot = function(origin, hit, part, dmg, char)
        lastTracerAt = os.clock()
        local cam = services.workspace.CurrentCamera
        if typeof(origin)~="Vector3" or typeof(hit)~="Vector3" or not cam then return end
        if vis.tracer then spawnTracer(muzzle(origin, cam), hit) end
        if vis.impact then spawnImpact(hit) end
        if vis.hitmarker then flashHitmarker() end
        if vis.dmgnum and type(dmg)=="number" and dmg>0 then spawnDamage(hit, dmg) end
        -- Track the candidate before replicated health changes; do not play on a predicted hit.
        feedback.track(char,hit)
    end
    aim.on_raycast = feedback.raycast
    aim.on_send = function()
        if not (vis.tracer and vis.tracerAll) then return end
        local t0 = os.clock()
        task.delay(0.06, function()
            if math.abs(lastTracerAt - t0) < 0.2 then return end
            local cam = services.workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then return end
            local lp = services.players.LocalPlayer
            local params = RaycastParams.new()
            params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {lp and lp.Character or nil, fxFolder}
            local o, dir = cam.CFrame.Position, cam.CFrame.LookVector * 600
            local r = services.workspace:Raycast(o, dir, params)
            spawnTracer(muzzle(o, cam), r and r.Position or (o + dir))
        end)
    end

    local function effectsStep(dt)
        ch.Visible = vis.crosshair and true or false
        chDot.Visible = vis.chDot and true or false
        updateChams()
        updateRadar()
        listTimer = listTimer + dt
        if listTimer > 0.25 then listTimer = 0 updateList() end
        if not immediate then
            lineUsed = 0
            pcall(drawLines)
            hideLines()
        end
        if vis.crosshair and vis.chColor == #palette then
            local col = pickColor(vis.chColor)
            for _,b in ipairs(chBars) do b.BackgroundColor3 = col end
            chDot.BackgroundColor3 = col
        end
        if vis.bright then
            lighting.Brightness, lighting.ClockTime, lighting.GlobalShadows = math.max(wd.fbPower, 0)/100, 14, false
            lighting.Ambient, lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(170,170,170), Color3.fromRGB(170,170,170)
        end
        if vis.nofog then
            lighting.FogEnd, lighting.FogStart = 1e9, 1e9
            if atmosphere then atmosphere.Density = 0 end
        end
        pcall(worldStep)
        local cam = services.workspace.CurrentCamera
        if vis.camfov and cam then cam.FieldOfView = vis.camfovVal end
        if vis.info then
            fpsAvg = fpsAvg + ((1/math.max(dt,1/1000)) - fpsAvg) * 0.08
            infoTimer = infoTimer + dt
            if infoTimer > 0.4 then
                infoTimer = 0
                local ping = 0
                pcall(function() ping = services.stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() end)
                infoText.Text = string.format("DaDa  |  %d FPS  |  %d ms", math.floor(fpsAvg+0.5), math.floor(ping+0.5))
            end
        end
    end


    -- Bridge existing gameplay controls to the supplied bloxscrike UI.
    local library={flags={},config_flags={},main_frame={}}
    library.__index=library
    local suppliedUI=D.ui(runtime,services)
    suppliedUI.ShowLoader=false
    local nativeWindow=suppliedUI:AddWindow("DaDa","","bloxscrike")
    library._window=nativeWindow
    library.main_frame[1]=nativeWindow:GetMainFrame()
    library.gui=library.main_frame[1]:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
    assert(library.gui,"DaDa: supplied UI did not create a ScreenGui")
    feedback.attach(library.main_frame[1],library.gui)
    getgenv().library=library
    runtime.teardown(function()
        if getgenv().library==library then getgenv().library=nil end
    end)
    function library:unload() runtime.release() end
    function library:create(class,properties,parent)
        local object=Instance.new(class)
        for key,value in pairs(properties or {}) do
            if key~="Parent" then object[key]=value end
        end
        object.Parent=parent or properties.Parent
        return object
    end
    function library:notification(properties)
        local toast=self:create("TextLabel",{
            Name="DaDaNotification",Parent=self.gui,
            AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,1),Position=UDim2.new(1,-16,1,-16),
            Size=UDim2.fromOffset(268,48),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(23,23,31),BackgroundTransparency=0.35,
            TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(226,228,236),TextWrapped=true,
            Font=Enum.Font.Gotham,TextSize=12,Text=tostring(properties.text or ""),
            BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=10000,
        })
        self:create("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,16)},toast)
        self:create("UIPadding",{PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,12),PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,12),
            PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,6),PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,6)},toast)
        runtime.spawn(function() task.wait(properties.time or 3);toast:Destroy() end)
    end
    function library:section(properties)
        local native=self.native:AddSection(properties.name,properties.side or "left")
        return {native=native,holder=native.holder}
    end
    function library:label(properties)
        return self:create("TextLabel",{
            Name="DaDaLabel",Parent=self.holder or self.native.left,
            Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,36),BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Font=Enum.Font.Gotham,TextSize=13,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(226,228,236),
            TextWrapped=true,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            Text=properties.name or properties.text or "",
        })
    end
    local function wrapControl(native,properties)
        local object={native=native}
        object.set=function(value) native:Set(value) end
        object.refresh_options=function(_,values) native:RefreshOptions(values) end
        if properties.flag then library.config_flags[properties.flag]=object.set end
        return object
    end
    function library:toggle(properties)
        local native=self._section:AddToggle(properties.name,properties.default,properties.callback)
        return wrapControl(native,properties)
    end
    function library:slider(properties)
        local step=properties.interval or 1
        local last
        local function callback(value)
            value=math.clamp(math.round(value/step)*step,properties.min,properties.max)
            if value==last then return end
            last=value
            properties.callback(value)
        end
        local native=self._section:AddSlider(properties.name,properties.min,properties.max,
            properties.default,callback,properties.suffix,step)
        return wrapControl(native,properties)
    end
    function library:colortoggle(properties)
        local native=self._section:AddToggleColorpicker(properties.name,properties.default,properties.color,
            properties.callback,properties.color_callback)
        local object={native=native}
        object.set=function(value) native:Set(value) end
        object.set_color=function(value) native:SetColor(value) end
        if properties.flag then library.config_flags[properties.flag]=object.set end
        return object
    end
    function library:colorpicker(properties)
        local native=self._section:AddColorpicker(properties.name,properties.default,properties.callback)
        local object={native=native}
        object.set=function(value) native:Set(value) end
        if properties.flag then library.config_flags[properties.flag]=object.set end
        return object
    end
    function library:dropdown(properties)
        return wrapControl(self._section:AddDropdown(properties.name,properties.items,
            properties.default,properties.callback),properties)
    end
    function library:button(properties)
        self._section:AddDescription(properties.name or properties.placeholder or "Ввод", properties.hint, "button")
        local button=self:create("TextButton",{
            Name="DaDaButton",Parent=self.holder,LayoutOrder=self._section:NextLayoutOrder(),Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,0,32),
            Text=properties.name or "Button",TextSize=13,Font=Enum.Font.Gotham,
            TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(226,228,236),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(30,33,47),
            BorderSizePixel=0,AutoButtonColor=true,
        })
        self:create("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6)},button)
        runtime.connect(button.Activated,properties.callback)
        return button
    end
    function library:textbox(properties)
        self._section:AddDescription(properties.name or properties.placeholder or "Ввод", properties.hint, "textbox")
        local field=self:create("TextBox",{
            Name="DaDaTextbox",Parent=self.holder,LayoutOrder=self._section:NextLayoutOrder(),Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,0,36),
            Text="",ClearTextOnFocus=false,PlaceholderText=properties.placeholder or "",
            TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(226,228,236),PlaceholderColor3=Color3.fromRGB(112,116,138),
            BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(26,26,36),BorderSizePixel=0,
            Font=Enum.Font.Gotham,TextSize=13,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        })
        self:create("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6)},field)
        runtime.connect(field:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"),function()
            if properties.callback then properties.callback(field.Text) end
        end)
        return {set=function(value)
            field.Text=tostring(value or "")
            if properties.callback then properties.callback(field.Text) end
        end}
    end
    local window={}
    function window:tab(properties)
        local native=nativeWindow:AddTab(properties.name,properties.name:lower())
        local page=setmetatable({native=native,tab_frame=native.left},library)
        page.open_tab=function() native:Activate() end
        return page
    end
    local pages={}
    for i,name in ipairs({"Combat","Visual","Effects","Movement","Config"}) do
        pages[i]=window:tab({name=name})
    end

    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- control registry (used by the config system)
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    local cfgRegistry, cfgOrder = {}, {}
    local pageNameOf = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    do
        local names = {"Combat","Visual","Effects","Movement","Config"}
        for i,p in ipairs(pages) do pageNameOf[p] = names[i] end
    end
    local function cfgRegister(page, name, kind, get, set, obj, toLabel)
        local base = (pageNameOf[page] or "?").."/"..name
        local key, n = base, 1
        while cfgRegistry[key] do n = n + 1; key = base.."#"..n end
        cfgRegistry[key] = {kind=kind, get=get, set=set, obj=obj, toLabel=toLabel}
        cfgOrder[#cfgOrder+1] = key
    end

    local sectionCount = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local function header(page, name)
        local n = (sectionCount[page] or 0) + 1
        sectionCount[page] = n
        local side=(n % 2 == 1) and "left" or "right"
        local section=page:section({name=name, side=side})
        page.holder=section.holder
        page._section=section.native
    end

    local function toggle(page, name, hint, get, set)
        page._section._dadaNextHint = hint
        local obj
        local default = get() and true or false
        obj = page:toggle({
            name=name,
            flag="dada_"..string.gsub(name,"%W","_").."_"..tostring(math.random(10000,99999)),
            default=default,
            callback=function(v)
                if v and page==pages[1] and not gameReady then
                    if obj then pcall(obj.set,false) end
                    warn("DaDa: this feature requires the original game's modules")
                    return
                end
                local ok, result = pcall(set, v)
                if ok and result == false and obj then
                    pcall(obj.set, not v)
                    return
                end
                if statusRefresh then pcall(statusRefresh) end
            end,
        })
        cfgRegister(page, name, "toggle", get, set, obj)
        return obj
    end

    local function slider(page, name, minV, maxV, step, get, set, suffix)
        local obj = page:slider({
            name=name,
            min=minV,
            max=maxV,
            interval=step,
            default=tonumber(get()) or minV,
            suffix=suffix or "",
            flag="dada_"..string.gsub(name,"%W","_").."_"..tostring(math.random(10000,99999)),
            callback=function(v)
                pcall(set,v)
                if statusRefresh then pcall(statusRefresh) end
            end,
        })
        cfgRegister(page, name, "slider", get, set, obj)
        return obj
    end

    local function choice(page, name, hint, options, get, set)
        page._section._dadaNextHint = hint
        local values, labels = {}, {}
        local current = get()
        for i,opt in ipairs(options) do
            local value,labelText = opt[1],opt[2]
            values[i], labels[i] = value,labelText
        end
        local defaultLabel
        for i,v in ipairs(values) do
            if v == current then defaultLabel=labels[i] break end
        end
        defaultLabel = defaultLabel or labels[1]
        local obj = page:dropdown({
            name=name,
            items=labels,
            default=defaultLabel,
            flag="dada_"..string.gsub(name,"%W","_").."_"..tostring(math.random(10000,99999)),
            callback=function(labelText)
                for i,labelValue in ipairs(labels) do
                    if labelValue == labelText then
                        pcall(set,values[i])
                        if statusRefresh then pcall(statusRefresh) end
                        break
                    end
                end
            end,
        })
        cfgRegister(page, name, "choice", get, set, obj, function(v)
            for i,val in ipairs(values) do
                if val == v then return labels[i] end
            end
            return nil
        end)
        return obj
    end

    -- colour controls (toggle + colour, stand-alone picker) and ESP row builder
    local function colorToggle(page, name, getOn, setOn, getCol, setCol)
        local obj
        obj = page:colortoggle({
            name=name,
            flag="dada_"..string.gsub(name,"%W","_").."_"..tostring(math.random(10000,99999)),
            default=getOn() and true or false,
            color=getCol(),
            callback=function(on)
                pcall(setOn, on and true or false)
                if statusRefresh then pcall(statusRefresh) end
            end,
            color_callback=function(c) pcall(setCol, c) end,
        })
        cfgRegister(page, name, "toggle", getOn, setOn, obj)
        cfgRegister(page, name.." (цвет)", "color", getCol, setCol, {set=function(c) obj.set_color(c) end})
        return obj
    end

    local function picker(page, name, getCol, setCol)
        local obj = page:colorpicker({
            name=name,
            flag="dada_"..string.gsub(name,"%W","_").."_"..tostring(math.random(10000,99999)),
            default=getCol(),
            callback=function(c) pcall(setCol, c) end,
        })
        cfgRegister(page, name, "color", getCol, setCol, obj)
        return obj
    end

    -- flag: enemy.<flag>; p: colour prefix (<p>Col, <p>GrdCol, <p>Grd).
    local function espItem(page, label, flag, p, posKey, posOpts, mirror)
        colorToggle(page, label,
            function() return enemy[flag] and true or false end,
            function(v) enemy[flag]=v if mirror then friendly[flag]=v end end,

                function() return enemy[posKey] end,
                function(v) enemy[posKey]=v if mirror then friendly[posKey]=v end end)

            function() return enemy[p.."Grd"] and true or false end,
            function(v) enemy[p.."Grd"]=v end)

    end

        menuOpen = v and true or false

    -- Mobile menu button: tap to toggle, drag to move independently of the menu.
    do
        if true then -- DaDa button on every platform
            local mobileGui=assert(services.screen(3000),"DaDa: mobile button GUI unavailable")
            mobileGui.Name="DaDaMobile"
            runtime.own(mobileGui)
            local button=library:create("TextButton",{
                Parent=mobileGui,Name="DaDaMobileToggle",Text="DaDa",
                Size=UDim2.fromOffset(56,56),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(23,27,39),
                BackgroundTransparency=0.08,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(238,241,247),
                Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold,TextSize=14,BorderSizePixel=0,
                AutoButtonColor=true,Active=true,Selectable=false,ZIndex=10,
            })
            library:create("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,16)},button)
            library:create("UIStroke",{Color=C.accent,Thickness=1.5},button)
            local pointer,pressPoint,pressOffset,lastPress
            local moved=false
            local function viewport()
                local camera=services.workspace.CurrentCamera
                return camera and camera.ViewportSize or mobileGui.AbsoluteSize
            end
            local function place(x,y)
                local size=viewport()
                button.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(
                    math.clamp(x,8,math.max(8,size.X-64)),
                    math.clamp(y,8,math.max(8,size.Y-64)))
            end
            local lastViewport=viewport()
            place(16,lastViewport.Y*0.45)
            runtime.connect(button.InputBegan,function(input)
                if pointer then return end
                if input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                    and input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
                pointer,lastPress=input,input
                moved=false
                pressPoint=Vector2.new(input.Position.X,input.Position.Y)
                pressOffset=Vector2.new(button.Position.X.Offset,button.Position.Y.Offset)
            end)
            runtime.connect(services.input.InputChanged,function(input)
                if not pointer then return end
                local mouseMove=pointer.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                    and input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                if input~=pointer and not mouseMove then return end
                local delta=Vector2.new(input.Position.X,input.Position.Y)-pressPoint
                if delta.X*delta.X+delta.Y*delta.Y>=100 then moved=true end
                if moved then place(pressOffset.X+delta.X,pressOffset.Y+delta.Y) end
            end)
            runtime.connect(services.input.InputEnded,function(input)
                if input~=pointer then return end
                if input.UserInputState==Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then moved=true end
                pointer=nil
            end)
            runtime.connect(button.Activated,function(input)
                if moved or (input and lastPress and input~=lastPress) then return end
                setOpen(not library._window:GetVisible())
            end)
            runtime.connect(mobileGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"),function()
                local size=viewport()
                if size==lastViewport then return end
                local position=button.Position
                local x=position.X.Offset/math.max(lastViewport.X,1)*size.X
                local y=position.Y.Offset/math.max(lastViewport.Y,1)*size.Y
                pointer=nil
                moved=true
                lastViewport=size
                place(x,y)
            end)
        end
    end
    -- End mobile menu button.

    runtime.connect(services.input.InputBegan,function(input,processed)
        if not processed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Insert then
            setOpen(not library._window:GetVisible())
        end
        if not processed and vis.tpKey and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.V then
            vis.tp=not vis.tp
            if statusRefresh then pcall(statusRefresh) end
        end
    end)

            ------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- MOVEMENT
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    local P4 = pages[4]
    local movement = {
        bhop=false, bhopSpeed=60, autoStrafe=false, edgeJump=false, jumpBug=false,
        edgeBug=false, slowWalk=false, pixelSurf=false, slowSpeed=8,
    }
    -- MovementV2 consumes SampleInput, rather than Humanoid velocity writes.
    local movementHooked=false
    local runtimeSettings,buttons
    do
        local folder=services.storage:FindFirstChild("MovementV2")
        local simulation=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Simulation")
        local settingsModule=simulation and simulation:FindFirstChild("RuntimeSettings")
        local buttonsModule=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Buttons")
        if settingsModule then local ok,value=pcall(require,settingsModule);if ok then runtimeSettings=value end end
        if buttonsModule then local ok,value=pcall(require,buttonsModule);if ok then buttons=value end end
    end
    local jumpMask=type(buttons)=="table" and buttons.Jump or 1
    local walkMask=type(buttons)=="table" and buttons.Walk or 4
    local lastConfigHz,lastConfig,commandCharacter,commandGrounded
    local function setButton(bits,mask,value)
        return value and bit32.bor(bits,mask) or bit32.band(bits,bit32.bnot(mask))
    end
    local function movementCommand(character,context,command)
        if not (movement.bhop or movement.autoStrafe or movement.edgeJump or movement.slowWalk) then return end
        if character.Player and character.Player~=lp then return end
        local state=type(context)=="table" and context.State or character.MovementState
        if type(state)~="table" then return end
        if commandCharacter~=character.Character then
            commandCharacter=character.Character;commandGrounded=nil
        end
        if state.MovementMode~=nil and state.MovementMode~="Walking" then commandGrounded=nil;return end
        local grounded=state.OnGround==true
        local move=typeof(command.Move)=="Vector2" and command.Move or Vector2.zero
        local moving=move.Magnitude>0.05
        local bits=tonumber(command.Buttons) or 0
        if movement.bhop and moving then bits=setButton(bits,jumpMask,grounded) end
        if movement.edgeJump and commandGrounded==true and not grounded and moving then
            bits=setButton(bits,jumpMask,true)
        end
        if movement.slowWalk and grounded then bits=setButton(bits,walkMask,true) end
        command.Buttons=bits
        commandGrounded=grounded
        if grounded or not moving or movement.slowWalk or not (movement.autoStrafe or movement.bhop) then return end
        local velocity=state.Velocity
        if typeof(velocity)~="Vector3" then return end
        local speed=Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z).Magnitude
        if speed<0.05 then return end
        local mapping=type(context)=="table" and context.Mapping
        local hz=type(mapping)=="table" and tonumber(mapping.SimulationHz)
        if hz~=lastConfigHz or lastConfig==nil then
            if hz and type(runtimeSettings)=="table" and type(runtimeSettings.getMovementConfig)=="function" then
                local ok,value=pcall(runtimeSettings.getMovementConfig,hz)
                if ok and type(value)=="table" then lastConfigHz,lastConfig=hz,value end
            end
        end
        local config=lastConfig or {}
        local dt=math.clamp((type(context)=="table" and tonumber(context.StepSeconds)) or 1/64,0.001,0.05)
        local base=math.clamp(tonumber(state.BaseMoveSpeed) or tonumber(config.MaxSpeed) or 18.75,0,tonumber(config.MaxBaseMoveSpeed) or 19.5)
        local stamina=math.clamp((tonumber(state.Stamina) or 100)/math.max(tonumber(config.StaminaMax) or 100,1),0,1)
        base=base*stamina*stamina
        local cap,acc
        if (tonumber(config.BunnyHopAirAccelerate) or 0)>0 and (tonumber(config.BunnyHopAirSpeedCap) or 0)>0 then
            cap=math.min(base,config.BunnyHopAirSpeedCap)
            acc=config.BunnyHopAirAccelerate*cap*dt
        else
            cap=math.min(base,tonumber(config.AirSpeedCap) or 2.25)
            acc=(tonumber(config.AirAccelerate) or 12)*base*dt*(tonumber(state.GroundSurfaceFriction) or 1)
        end
        local yaw=tonumber(command.LookYaw) or tonumber(state.LookYaw) or 0
        local sn,cs=math.sin(yaw),math.cos(yaw)
        local localVelocity=Vector2.new(cs*velocity.X-sn*velocity.Z,sn*velocity.X+cs*velocity.Z)/speed
        local target=math.clamp(tonumber(movement.bhopSpeed) or 60,1,150)
        local gameCap=tonumber(config.BunnyHopSpeedCap) or 0
        if gameCap>0 then target=math.min(target,gameCap) end
        if speed>=target then command.Move=localVelocity;return end
        -- Shitaro's air acceleration: leave room below the wish-speed cap.
        local projection=math.max(cap-acc,0)
        local cosine=math.clamp(projection/speed,-1,1)
        local sine=math.sqrt(math.max(1-cosine*cosine,0))
        local perpendicular=Vector2.new(-localVelocity.Y,localVelocity.X)
        local left=localVelocity*cosine+perpendicular*sine
        local right=localVelocity*cosine-perpendicular*sine
        command.Move=left:Dot(move)>=right:Dot(move) and left or right
    end
    if type(api.character)=="table" and type(api.character.SampleInput)=="function" then
        local original=runtime.field(api.character,"SampleInput",function(sample)
            return function(character,context,...)
                local result=table.pack(sample(character,context,...))
                if type(result[1])=="table" then movementCommand(character,context,result[1]) end
                return table.unpack(result,1,result.n)
            end
        end)
        movementHooked=type(original)=="function" and api.character.SampleInput~=original
    end
    local movementConn
    local lastGrounded=false
    local lastJump=0
    local oldWalkSpeed=nil
    local function getHumanoid()
        local ch=lp.Character
        return ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end
    local function getRoot()
        local ch=lp.Character
        return ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
    local function movementStep()
        if not (movement.bhop or movement.autoStrafe or movement.edgeJump or movement.jumpBug
            or movement.edgeBug or movement.slowWalk or movement.pixelSurf or oldWalkSpeed~=nil) then
            lastGrounded=false;return
        end
        local hum=getHumanoid()
        local root=getRoot()
        if not hum or not root then return end
        local grounded=hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
        local now=os.clock()

        if not movementHooked and movement.bhop and grounded and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude>0.05 and now-lastJump>0.08 then
            hum.Jump=true
            lastJump=now
        end

        if not movementHooked and movement.autoStrafe and not grounded and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude>0.05 then
            local md=hum.MoveDirection
            local vel=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local horizontal=Vector3.new(vel.X,0,vel.Z)
            if horizontal.Magnitude<1 then
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(md.X*hum.WalkSpeed,vel.Y,md.Z*hum.WalkSpeed)
            else
                local target=md.Unit*math.max(horizontal.Magnitude,hum.WalkSpeed*0.75)
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(target.X,vel.Y,target.Z)
            end
        end

        if not movementHooked and movement.edgeJump and lastGrounded and not grounded and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude>0.05 then
            hum.Jump=true
        end

        if movement.jumpBug and not grounded and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y<0 and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y>-8 then
            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end

        if movement.edgeBug and not grounded and math.abs(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y)<5 then
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X,0,root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
        end

        if movement.slowWalk then
            if oldWalkSpeed==nil then oldWalkSpeed=hum.WalkSpeed end
            hum.WalkSpeed=movement.slowSpeed
        elseif oldWalkSpeed~=nil then
            hum.WalkSpeed=oldWalkSpeed
            oldWalkSpeed=nil
        end

        -- Bhop speed only changes the horizontal velocity; jump height is preserved.
        -- Run after Auto Strafe so that it cannot overwrite the selected speed.
        -- Slow Walk retains priority while both features are enabled.
        if not movementHooked and movement.bhop and hum.Health>0 and not hum.Sit and not hum.PlatformStand then
            local direction=hum.MoveDirection
            local horizontalDirection=Vector3.new(direction.X,0,direction.Z)
            local state=hum:GetState()
            local canMove=grounded or state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
                or state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
            if canMove and horizontalDirection.Magnitude>0.05 then
                local speed=math.clamp(tonumber(movement.bhopSpeed) or 60,1,150)
                if movement.slowWalk then
                    speed=math.min(speed,movement.slowSpeed)
                end
                local velocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                local target=horizontalDirection.Unit*speed
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(target.X,velocity.Y,target.Z)
            end
        end

        if movement.pixelSurf and not grounded and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude>0.05 then
            local v=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            if v.Y<0 and v.Y>-35 then
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(v.X,math.max(v.Y,-2),v.Z)
            end
        end
        lastGrounded=grounded
    end
    movementConn=runtime.connect(services.run.RenderStepped,movementStep)
    runtime.teardown(function()
        if movementConn then pcall(function() movementConn:Disconnect() end) end
        local hum=getHumanoid()
        if hum and oldWalkSpeed then hum.WalkSpeed=oldWalkSpeed end
        oldWalkSpeed=nil
    end)

    header(P4,"Movement")
    toggle(P4,"Bhop","Автопрыжки и разгон через команды MovementV2",function() return movement.bhop end,function(v) movement.bhop=v end)
    slider(P4,"Предел разгона Bhop",1,150,1,function() return movement.bhopSpeed end,function(v)
        movement.bhopSpeed=math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 60,1,150)
    end," studs/s")
    toggle(P4,"Auto Strafe","Автоматически поддерживает движение в воздухе",function() return movement.autoStrafe end,function(v) movement.autoStrafe=v end)
    toggle(P4,"Edge Jump","Автоматически выполняет прыжок при сходе с края",function() return movement.edgeJump end,function(v) movement.edgeJump=v end)
    toggle(P4,"Jump Bug","Пытается сохранить прыжковое состояние при приземлении",function() return movement.jumpBug end,function(v) movement.jumpBug=v end)
    toggle(P4,"Edge Bug","Пытается уменьшить вертикальную скорость у края",function() return movement.edgeBug end,function(v) movement.edgeBug=v end)
    toggle(P4,"Slow Walk","Ограничивает скорость передвижения",function() return movement.slowWalk end,function(v) movement.slowWalk=v end)
    slider(P4,"Скорость Slow Walk",1,16,0.5,function() return movement.slowSpeed end,function(v) movement.slowSpeed=v end)
    toggle(P4,"Pixel Surf","Пытается удерживать движение по поверхности при падении",function() return movement.pixelSurf end,function(v) movement.pixelSurf=v end)

    statusRefresh=function() end

    do
        local ok, message = pcall(D.skinPort, services, api, runtime, window, library, cfgRegister, pageNameOf)
        if not ok then warn("DaDa / skin setup: "..tostring(message)) end
        local knifeOK,knifeError=pcall(D.skinPort,services,api,runtime,window,library,cfgRegister,pageNameOf,true)
        if not knifeOK then warn("DaDa / knife setup: "..tostring(knifeError)) end
    end

    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- CONFIGS: save / load / delete / share by code
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    do
        local P7 = pages[5]
        local http = game:GetService("HttpService")
        local DIR = "DaDa/configs"
        local AUTO = "DaDa/autoload.txt"
        local hasFS = type(writefile)=="function" and type(readfile)=="function"
            and type(isfile)=="function" and type(listfiles)=="function" and type(makefolder)=="function"
        if hasFS then
            pcall(makefolder, "DaDa")
            pcall(makefolder, DIR)
        end
        local function notify(text)
            pcall(function() library:notification({text=text, time=3}) end)
        end

        -- base64
        local B64 = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
        local B64rev = {}
        for i=1,64 do B64rev[B64:sub(i,i)] = i-1 end
        local function b64enc(data)
            local out = {}
            for i = 1, #data, 3 do
                local a, b, c = data:byte(i, i+2)
                local n = a*65536 + (b or 0)*256 + (c or 0)
                local c1 = math.floor(n/262144) % 64
                local c2 = math.floor(n/4096) % 64
                local c3 = math.floor(n/64) % 64
                local c4 = n % 64
                out[#out+1] = B64:sub(c1+1,c1+1)..B64:sub(c2+1,c2+1)
                    ..(b and B64:sub(c3+1,c3+1) or "=")..(c and B64:sub(c4+1,c4+1) or "=")
            end
            return table.concat(out)
        end
        local function b64dec(s)
            s = (s:gsub("[^%w%+/=]",""))
            local out = {}
            for i = 1, #s, 4 do
                local a, b, c, d = s:sub(i,i), s:sub(i+1,i+1), s:sub(i+2,i+2), s:sub(i+3,i+3)
                local n = (B64rev[a] or 0)*262144 + (B64rev[b] or 0)*4096 + (B64rev[c] or 0)*64 + (B64rev[d] or 0)
                out[#out+1] = string.char(math.floor(n/65536) % 256)
                if c ~= "=" and c ~= "" then out[#out+1] = string.char(math.floor(n/256) % 256) end
                if d ~= "=" and d ~= "" then out[#out+1] = string.char(n % 256) end
            end
            return table.concat(out)
        end

        -- snapshot / apply
        local function snapshot()
            local data = {}
            for _,key in ipairs(cfgOrder) do
                local e = cfgRegistry[key]
                local ok, v = pcall(e.get)
                if ok and v ~= nil then
                    if e.kind == "toggle" then data[key] = v and true or false
                    elseif e.kind == "slider" then data[key] = tonumber(v)
                    elseif e.kind == "color" then
                        if typeof(v) == "Color3" then
                            data[key] = {math.floor(v.R*255+0.5), math.floor(v.G*255+0.5), math.floor(v.B*255+0.5)}
                        end
                    else data[key] = v end
                end
            end
            return data
        end
        local function applyEntry(e, v)
            local arg = v
            if e.kind == "choice" then
                arg = e.toLabel and e.toLabel(v)
                if arg == nil then return false end
            elseif e.kind == "toggle" then
                arg = v and true or false
            elseif e.kind == "slider" then
                arg = tonumber(v)
                if not arg then return false end
            elseif e.kind == "color" then
                if type(v) ~= "table" or type(v[1]) ~= "number" or type(v[2]) ~= "number" or type(v[3]) ~= "number" then return false end
                arg = Color3.fromRGB(v[1], v[2], v[3])
            end
            if e.obj and type(e.obj.set) == "function" then
                if pcall(e.obj.set, arg) then return true end
            end
            return (pcall(e.set, e.kind == "choice" and v or arg))
        end
        local function applyData(data)
            local n = 0
            -- turn things on first, then values, then turn off (keeps "at least one hitbox" rule happy)
            for _,key in ipairs(cfgOrder) do
                local e, v = cfgRegistry[key], data[key]
                if v == true and e.kind == "toggle" and applyEntry(e, v) then n = n + 1 end
            end
            for _,key in ipairs(cfgOrder) do
                local e, v = cfgRegistry[key], data[key]
                if v ~= nil and e.kind ~= "toggle" and applyEntry(e, v) then n = n + 1 end
            end
            for _,key in ipairs(cfgOrder) do
                local e, v = cfgRegistry[key], data[key]
                if v == false and e.kind == "toggle" and applyEntry(e, v) then n = n + 1 end
            end
            if statusRefresh then pcall(statusRefresh) end
            return n
        end
        local function encodeJson(data) return http:JSONEncode({v=1, d=data}) end
        local function decodeJson(json)
            local ok, t = pcall(function() return http:JSONDecode(json) end)
            if not ok or type(t) ~= "table" or type(t.d) ~= "table" then return nil end
            return t.d
        end
        local function encodeCode(data) return "DADA1:"..b64enc(encodeJson(data)) end
        local function decodeCode(str)
            str = (tostring(str or ""):gsub("%s",""))
            if str:sub(1,6) ~= "DADA1:" then return nil, "Неверный код конфига" end
            local ok, json = pcall(b64dec, str:sub(7))
            if not ok then return nil, "Не удалось прочитать код" end
            local data = decodeJson(json)
            if not data then return nil, "Конфиг повреждён" end
            return data
        end

        local function cleanName(n)
            n = tostring(n or ""):gsub('[\\/:*?"<>|]', "")
            n = n:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            return n
        end
        local function listConfigs()
            local names = {}
            if not hasFS then return names end
            local ok, files = pcall(listfiles, DIR)
            if ok and type(files) == "table" then
                for _,p in ipairs(files) do
                    local nm = tostring(p):match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")
                    if nm then names[#names+1] = nm end
                end
            end
            table.sort(names)
            return names
        end

        local nameValue, codeValue, selected = "", "", nil
        local listDrop, codeBox
        local EMPTY = "(нет конфигов)"
        local function refreshList(pick)
            local names = listConfigs()
            listDrop:refresh_options(#names > 0 and names or {EMPTY})
            if not pick or not table.find(names, pick) then pick = names[1] end
            selected = pick
            listDrop.set(pick or EMPTY)
        end
        local function loadFile(name)
            local path = DIR.."/"..name..".json"
            if not isfile(path) then return false, "Файл не найден" end
            local ok, json = pcall(readfile, path)
            if not ok then return false, "Не удалось прочитать файл" end
            local data = decodeJson(json)
            if not data then return false, "Конфиг повреждён" end
            return true, applyData(data)
        end

        ----------------------------------------------------------- UI
        header(P7, "Конфиги")
        P7:textbox({
            placeholder = "Имя нового конфига",
            flag = "dada_cfg_name",
            callback = function(t) nameValue = t end,
        })
        listDrop = P7:dropdown({
            name = "Сохранённые",
            items = {EMPTY},
            default = EMPTY,
            flag = "dada_cfg_list",
            callback = function(label)
                selected = (label and label ~= EMPTY) and label or nil
            end,
        })
        P7:button({name = "Сохранить конфиг", callback = function()
            if not hasFS then notify("Файлы недоступны — используй код конфига") return end
            local n = cleanName(nameValue)
            if n == "" then n = selected or "default" end
            local ok = pcall(writefile, DIR.."/"..n..".json", encodeJson(snapshot()))
            if ok then notify("Конфиг сохранён: "..n) refreshList(n) else notify("Не удалось сохранить конфиг") end
        end})
        P7:button({name = "Загрузить выбранный", callback = function()
            if not hasFS then notify("Файлы недоступны — используй код конфига") return end
            if not selected then notify("Сначала выбери конфиг") return end
            local ok, res = loadFile(selected)
            if ok then notify("Загружено: "..selected.." ("..tostring(res).." настроек)") else notify(tostring(res)) end
        end})
        P7:button({name = "Удалить выбранный", callback = function()
            if not hasFS or not selected then notify("Нечего удалять") return end
            if type(delfile) ~= "function" then notify("delfile не поддерживается") return end
            local path = DIR.."/"..selected..".json"
            if pcall(delfile, path) then notify("Удалён: "..selected) refreshList() else notify("Не удалось удалить") end
        end})
        P7:button({name = "Обновить список", callback = function()
            refreshList(selected)
            notify("Найдено конфигов: "..tostring(#listConfigs()))
        end})
        P7:toggle({
            name = "Автозагрузка выбранного",
            flag = "dada_cfg_autoload",
            default = (hasFS and isfile(AUTO)) and true or false,
            callback = function(v)
                if not hasFS then return end
                if v and selected then
                    pcall(writefile, AUTO, selected)
                elseif not v and type(delfile) == "function" and isfile(AUTO) then
                    pcall(delfile, AUTO)
                end
            end,
        })

        header(P7, "Передача конфига")
        P7:button({name = "Экспорт: получить код", callback = function()
            local code = encodeCode(snapshot())
            codeBox.set(code)
            if type(setclipboard) == "function" then
                pcall(setclipboard, code)
                notify("Код конфига скопирован в буфер")
            else
                notify("Код в поле ниже — скопируй его вручную")
            end
        end})
        codeBox = P7:textbox({
            placeholder = "Код конфига (вставь сюда для импорта)",
            flag = "dada_cfg_code",
            callback = function(t) codeValue = t end,
        })
        P7:button({name = "Импорт: применить код из поля", callback = function()
            local data, err = decodeCode(codeValue)
            if not data then notify(err) return end
            notify("Конфиг применён ("..tostring(applyData(data)).." настроек)")
        end})
        if type(getclipboard) == "function" then
            P7:button({name = "Импорт: взять код из буфера", callback = function()
                local ok, text = pcall(getclipboard)
                local data, err = decodeCode(ok and text or "")
                if not data then notify(err) return end
                notify("Конфиг применён ("..tostring(applyData(data)).." настроек)")
            end})
        end
        P7:button({name = "Выключить все функции", callback = function()
            local data = {}
            for _,key in ipairs(cfgOrder) do
                if cfgRegistry[key].kind == "toggle" then data[key] = false end
            end
            applyData(data)
            notify("Все переключатели выключены")
        end})

        ----------------------------------------------------------- startup
        if hasFS then
            refreshList()
            pcall(function()
                if isfile(AUTO) then
                    local n = cleanName(readfile(AUTO))
                    if n ~= "" then
                        local ok = loadFile(n)
                        if ok then refreshList(n) end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    -- UI-only MM2 modules use the existing window and its native tab system.
    do
        local ok,message=pcall(D.installMusicUI,runtime,nativeWindow,library.gui,library.main_frame[1])
        if not ok then warn("[DaDa Music] "..tostring(message)) end
        -- Config was created earlier to preserve its existing configuration IDs.
        -- Move only its sidebar row after every added tab, including skin tabs.
        for _,item in ipairs(library.main_frame[1]:GetDescendants()) do
            if item:IsA("TextLabel") and item.Name=="TabText" and item.Text=="Config" then
                local row=item.Parent
                if row and row.Name=="TabButton" then row.LayoutOrder=1000000 end
            end
        end
    end

    statusRefresh=function() end
    pages[1].open_tab()

    runtime.own(library.gui)

    local warned={}
    local function safely(name, fn)
        local ok,err=pcall(fn)
        if not ok and not warned[name] then
            warned[name]=true
            warn("DaDa / "..name..": "..tostring(err))
            status.Text="Ошибка "..name.." — смотри консоль"
        end
    end
    runtime.connect(services.run.Heartbeat,function()
        safely("weapon",profiles.ensure)
        safely("auto shoot",hooks.auto)
    end)
    runtime.bind(Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+3,function()
        safely("tracking",tracker.step)
    end)
    runtime.bind(Enum.RenderPriority.First.Value,function() pcall(tpUndo) end)
    runtime.bind(Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+10,function() safely("third person",tpApply) end)
    runtime.bind(Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value+1,function(dt)
        safely("esp",painter.pump)
        safely("fov ring",updateRing)
        safely("effects",function() effectsStep(tonumber(dt) or 1/60) end)
    end)
    runtime.teardown(function()
        want.auto,want.esp=false,false
        aim.on,aim.auto_shoot,enemy.en=false,false,false
        aim.draw_fov=false
        aim.rapid,aim.double_tap=false,false
        aim.no_recoil,aim.no_spread,aim.insta_reload=false,false,false
        aim.on_shot,aim.on_send,aim.on_raycast=nil,nil,nil
        vis.bright,vis.nofog,vis.camfov=false,false,false
        restoreBright(); restoreFog(); restoreWorld()
        pcall(fxCleanup)
        pcall(function() fxFolder:Destroy() end)
        if getgenv().DaDa then getgenv().DaDa=nil end
    end)
    getgenv().DaDa={Unload=runtime.release}
    runtime.publish(runtime.release)
    services.reclaim()
    return true
end
local success, err=xpcall(startDaDa,function(message)
    if debug and type(debug.traceback)=="function" then
        return debug.traceback(tostring(message),2)
    end
    return tostring(message)
end)
if not success then
    runtime.release()
    warn("DaDa: "..tostring(err))
    return false
end
return true
